function ctsAchievement(achievement, difficultyChecker = true){
	if ((difficultyChecker && campaignTrail_temp.difficulty_level_multiplier<=1)||!difficultyChecker)
		if(campaignTrail_temp.CTS){
		unlockAchievement(achievement);
	}
}

function updateQuestionBanner() {
    if (e.VPisCandidate !== 0) return;
    
    const questionBanner = document.getElementById("campaign_sign");
    if (questionBanner?.nodeName !== "DIV") return;
    
    // find matching variant or use default
    const variant = bannerConfig.variants.find(v => v.condition());
    const src = variant?.src || bannerConfig.default;
    
    const img = document.createElement('img');
    img.src = src;
    img.width = bannerConfig.width;
    img.height = bannerConfig.height;
    
    questionBanner.replaceWith(img);
}

function getTooltips(str) {
    let matches = [];

    tooltipList.forEach((tooltip, index) => {
        // Adjust the regex to match searchString potentially surrounded by “ and followed by optional punctuation
       let regex = new RegExp(`(?<=\\b|\\s|^|“)${tooltip.searchString}(?=[.,;!?]?\\b|\\s|”|$)`, 'g');


        let match;
        while ((match = regex.exec(str)) !== null) {
            matches.push({
                start: match.index + (match[0].startsWith('“') ? 1 : 0), // Adjust for potential starting “
                end: match.index + match[0].length - (match[0].endsWith('”') ? 1 : 0) - (match[2] ? 1 : 0), 
                tooltipIndex: index
            });
        }
    });

    // Sort by starting position; if two start at the same position, longer match comes first
    matches.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start || b.end - b.start - (a.end - a.start));

    // Filter out overlaps
    for (let i = 0; i < matches.length - 1; ) {
        if (matches[i + 1].start < matches[i].end) {
            matches.splice(i + 1, 1); // Remove the next match since it overlaps
        } else {
            i++; // Move to next match
        }
    }

    return matches;
}
function applyTooltips(str) {
    const matches = getTooltips(str);
    let result = '';
    let lastIndex = 0;

    matches.forEach(match => {
        const tooltip = tooltipList[match.tooltipIndex];
        result += str.slice(lastIndex, match.start);
        result += `<span class='mytooltip'>${tooltip.searchString}<span class='mytooltiptext'>${tooltip.explanationText}</span></span>`;
        lastIndex = match.end;
    });

    result += str.slice(lastIndex); // Add the remainder of the original string
    return result;
}

function applyTooltipsToObject(obj) {
    for (let key in obj) {
        if (typeof obj[key] === 'string') {
            obj[key] = applyTooltips(obj[key]);
        } else if (typeof obj[key] === 'object') {
            applyTooltipsToObject(obj[key]); // Recursive call
        }
    }
}

applyTooltipsToObject(campaignTrail_temp.questions_json);
applyTooltipsToObject(campaignTrail_temp.answers_json);
applyTooltipsToObject(campaignTrail_temp.answer_feedback_json);

function changeChart() {
    targetIds.forEach(id => {
        const element = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!element) return;
        
        let html = element.innerHTML;
        let changed = false;
        
        replacements.forEach(([from, to]) => {
            if (html.includes(from)) {
                html = html.replaceAll(from, to);
                changed = true;
            }
        });
        
        if (changed) {
            element.innerHTML = html;
        }
    });
}

const changeChartObserver = new MutationObserver(changeChart);
if (gameWindow) {
    changeChartObserver.observe(gameWindow, { subtree: true, childList: true });
}

function getIdeology(ext, theo) {
    // check quadrants first (both axes beyond ±5)
    if (ext > 5 && theo < -5) return 'Worldview: Hegelian';
    if (ext > 5 && theo > 5) return 'Worldview: Reterritorializing';
    if (ext < -5 && theo < -5) return 'Worldview: Metempsychotic';
    if (ext < -5 && theo > 5) return 'Worldview: Prelapsarian';
    
    // check single-axis dominance
    if (theo > 5) return 'Worldview: Deterritorializing';
    if (theo < -5) return 'Worldview: Millenarian';
    
    return 'Worldview: Amorphous';
}

function updateMarker() {
    if (!compassDiv || !marker || !caption) return;

    const centerX = compassDiv.offsetWidth / 2;
    const centerY = compassDiv.offsetHeight / 2;

    marker.style.left = `${centerX + (state.theosophia * centerX / 100)}px`;
    marker.style.top = `${centerY - (state.externalizing * centerY / 100)}px`;
    caption.innerText = getIdeology(state.externalizing, state.theosophia);
}

function toggleDodikCompass() {
    const popup = document.getElementById('compass_popup');
    if (!popup) return;
    
    const isVisible = popup.style.display !== 'none';
    popup.style.display = isVisible ? 'none' : 'block';
    sessionStorage.setItem('compassOpen', !isVisible);
    
    // update marker when opening - fixes an issue with the original compass
    if (isVisible === false) {
        updateMarker();
    }
}

function createAxisLabel(text, position) {
    const label = document.createElement('div');
    label.className = 'axis-label';
    label.innerText = text;
    
    const positions = {
        top: { top: '0', left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)' },
        bottom: { bottom: '0', left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)' },
        left: { left: '0', top: '45%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)' },
        right: { right: '0', top: '55%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)' }
    };
    
    Object.assign(label.style, positions[position]);
    return label;
}

function makeDraggable(element, handle) {
    let offsetX, offsetY;

    handle.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        offsetX = e.clientX - element.offsetLeft;
        offsetY = e.clientY - element.offsetTop;
        
        const onMouseMove = (e) => {
            element.style.left = `${e.clientX - offsetX}px`;
            element.style.top = `${e.clientY - offsetY}px`;
        };
        
        const onMouseUp = () => {
            document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
            document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
        };
        
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
        document.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
    });
}

function openDodikCompass() {
    if (document.getElementById('compass_popup')) return;
    
    injectStyles();

    // create popup
    const popup = document.createElement('div');
    popup.id = 'compass_popup';
    popup.style.display = sessionStorage.getItem('compassOpen') === 'true' ? 'block' : 'none';

    // title bar
    const titleBar = document.createElement('div');
    titleBar.id = 'compassTitleBar';
    titleBar.innerHTML = '<span>DODIKOSCOPE</span>';

    // compass container
    compassDiv = document.createElement('div');
    compassDiv.id = 'compass';

    // axes
    const verticalAxis = document.createElement('div');
    verticalAxis.className = 'axis vertical';
    
    const horizontalAxis = document.createElement('div');
    horizontalAxis.className = 'axis horizontal';

    // marker
    marker = document.createElement('div');
    marker.id = 'marker';

    // caption
    caption = document.createElement('div');
    caption.id = 'dodik_ideology';

    // assemble compass
    compassDiv.append(
        verticalAxis,
        horizontalAxis,
        marker,
        createAxisLabel('Externalizing', 'top'),
        createAxisLabel('Internalizing', 'bottom'),
        createAxisLabel('Theosophia', 'left'),
        createAxisLabel('Anthroposophia', 'right')
    );

    // assemble popup
    popup.append(titleBar, compassDiv, caption);
    document.body.appendChild(popup);

    makeDraggable(popup, titleBar);
    updateMarker();
}

function addDodikCompass() {
    if (document.getElementById('dodik_compass')) return;
    
    const refButton = document.getElementById('view_electoral_map');
    if (!refButton) return;

    const newButton = document.createElement('button');
    newButton.id = 'dodik_compass';
    newButton.textContent = 'Compass';
    newButton.addEventListener('click', toggleDodikCompass);
    
    refButton.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', newButton);
    openDodikCompass();
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', addDodikCompass);

function handleEndingImage(resultsDesc) {
    const candImg = document.querySelector(".person_image");
    if (!candImg) return;
    
    if (e.image === true) {
        candImg.remove();
    } else if (e.image) {

    }
    
    Object.assign(resultsDesc.style, RESULTS_STYLE);
}

function construct(a = 1) {
    // update page index
    e.page = e.page + a < e.pages.length ? e.page + a : 0;
    
    // build HTML
    let html = e.header + e.pages[e.page] + "<br>";
    
    if (e.page > 0) {
        html += `<button onclick='endingConstructor(-1)'>Back</button>`;
    }
    if (e.page < e.pages.length - 1) {
        html += `<button onclick='endingConstructor(1)'>Next</button>`;
    }
    
    // execute page-specific functions
    for (const [page, fn] of e.executable) {
        if (page === e.page) {
            fn();
        }
    }
    
    return html;
}

const endingConstructor = (a = 1) => {
    const resultsElement = document.getElementById('final_results_description');
    if (!resultsElement) return;
    
    resultsElement.innerHTML = construct(a);
    
    if (e.image) {
        handleEndingImage(resultsElement);
    }
    
    resultsElement.scrollTop = 0;
};

I admit it i concede i never outgrew the biologically sentimental sensibilities of my petty-bourgeoisie parents my family of clerks and lawyers and officers i inherited the sickness that makes me love myself that makes me fall in love with my own memories as if they’re so fucking important but i know everyone did too. This world. And this isn’t an ego-trip my sentimentality isn’t inward it’s all about wanting somebody to see it. I want somebody to see it. I’m so desperate for all my memories to be objects because if i can trace everything that ever changed me into a precise memory a set of geographic coordinates a collection of topographic data and geometric proportions then i can figure out exactly what i’m composed of i can see all at once my shape and be hit with the kind of clarity that only hits people when they know all of themselves when they’re about to die and my childhood is the biggest object of them all. The parts of my childhood that mattered and were good. And there’s so few of that I know there’s so few of that but all of them absolutely all of them are here were here and i don’t mean they just took place here i don’t mean this was their arbitrary backdrop i mean this is it this is it. You can reach out and feel it it’s the way that the sunlight reflects off of the the blue bridge leading into town right by the little church where my father is going to be buried because burial it’s free there and we’re destitute now or the exact color on the exact exact exact tin-rusted texture of the dumpster across the street from the computer lab that had the only computers that existed in this town in the late 2000s and early 2010s which i’m pretty sure was just called a ‘Library’ even though it was an apartment-sized space with maybe 5 computers from the 90s and all of the 6 children in Crna Trava would convene there all day and i don’t know where they are now i mean they’re definitely not here but what i want to say is that i want you to be able to feel this object. Who are you? I want you to reach out your hand And i want you to fucking touch it because I want someone to look at me and I want them to understand. And there’s no other way. There’s just no other way. It’s all that i’ve dreamed of ever since i was a kid before i even had a concept of romantic affection before the world had revealed itself to me in a future where i imagined myself with a partner in this life all i could imagine was talking walks with them. Here. Down here. And i would lead them down the path where a tall tree on the forest off the side of the road that stretches into the sky still has the markings from when me and my cousins carved our initials into it clear as day right fucking there in the bark and i would lead them down the downhill trail that an organizer from town would take kids down and let them play in this huge field football league though i was never good at football and the goals were made of huge branches picked off the forest floor and i would take their hand and to the exact geographic locations and describe to you every single detail of every single memory that i could remember and push through the ones i couldn’t .Because i want someone to be submerged in the object. I want to love someone when i love myself. I want us both to be obsessed with one-another in the way you can only be obsessed with your own childhood and i want it to radiate outwards and change this world and mwe I don’t know why i’m crying right now Please be somewhere</p>

			<p>My mind is porous and empty when i hold my own hand when i leave the car and start walking uphill towards my paternal grandfather’s house. There was something there and it’s not here anymore.  I’m so fucking sorry i’m like this This little river flows down and through the gravel path i’m walking on right now passing through this really thin reservoir you can almost see at the bottom of the forestbed if you peak your head over the trail but the height always scared me so much as a kid. I remember walking down here when i was a small kid too small to be walking around the woods unsupervised and i would sit on a little rock and count all the insects. One, two, three. Black bodies with red patterns and spots but they weren’t ladybugs they always crawled through the holes in the treebark and i loved them so much but they’re no where anymore. I identified with the insects and wanted to punish the animals that killed them and saw them as lesser just because they were smaller, just because you couldn’t see them, just because you had to focus on them to see their beauty. I almost murdered my older brother with a rock when he killed a moth. The really wide horizontal vacation house to the right of my grandfather’s house How do i not see it? It’s literally right there peeking beyond the front-gate. I just have to take a few steps on the trail to the right and i’m basically level with their backgarden and when i am there’s this little monument it’s like a small spomenik carved out of wood and decorated with a glossy oval photo like the kind you see attached to graves behind all the white lawn chairs and the big lawn table the kind with the hole in the middle that you put the big green umbrella in and i’m pretty sure it hasn’t been touched in a literal decade but it’s a monument to the patriarch of the family that owns the house. Owned it? and he died. A partisan in some war. Some war i don’t know i don’t remember. In 2013 when i was seven years old they stayed there for the summer at the same time my family did and their dad would let me use their wifi to watch pewdiepie’s playthrough of the deadpool game for xbox 360 on my dad’s tablet</p>
			
			<p>In spring of some year my entire family got away here to avoid the pandemic. Which one? It was like heaven. And one day all four of us took a walk, and i’m pretty sure that’s the only time in my life that’s happened, and we took this off-beaten path at some point and walked through the forest completely blind for 30 minutes before ending off at a clearing that was right right right above our house and all we had to do was slide down the side and we were right at our gate, and that’s the last memory i have of my family all together, this little slice of existence in which each of us played our conversational role existed as one organism, before it all went really really bad. Sitting here a light flickers in my mind and for a single second i feel solved. And you know everyone who always grows up alone and isolated arguably neglected and silently craving small acts of physical intimacy for the better half of two decades always ends up disappointed when physical affection gives them nothing of what they think they want when i was first hugged at sixteen i felt like i was going to vomit because all i felt was a mild anatomical discomfort and a resulting need to correct that discomfort and it was a nightmarish nausea because the world closed itself off to me all at once because what they think they want is really this mental desire this total conceptual physiomental need to know that they are not the only human being in the universe and even when it is proven to a sufficient capacity it’s  like .ok so awesome people exist & im not alone on the surface of the earth big whoop what am i supposed to do ask them how their day is going, whats the point of march twenty fifth 2025, how do i everything, instantly constantly. And then it goes away in an instant the world feels like it always has and  i feel like if you were here these words wouldn’t exist and the nice thing would be allowed. History would dissolve and all of the cruel things History means too. It’s like how i imagined as a kid it really would work to be accepted into the inner layer of reality where everyone else exists in all the time. There was something there and it’s not here anymore</p>
			
			<p>I get it now, that i am going to die. Red and white and green data transmissions, cosmic static data overtaking the edges of my mind, protruding outwards from the ground. And i know it means the end of my wworld and i never put it in anyones hands and i know that i am going to die because even when i dream i can’t remember your face anymore. And at the end at the core all else removed it’s just me, and I need to be maximally sincere, I need to be honest and good, but i cant because this is it . I’m not strong.I wish you were here.</p>
			
			<p>Please don’t look at the sky. It’s all going wrong.</p>

̢̡̧̨̧̯̩͖̻̯͈̖̦̰̙͎̟͉͉͖̲̹̯͇͙̤̞͍̜͖̲̫͇̝̪̜̤̺̫̀̀̀͋̐̈́̓͛̿̒͂̋́̇̕͜Ǵ̴̛̬̻͙̯͙̓̍͒̀̽̈́̈̉̃̿̈́̆͛̊̌̀̇̀̀͐̑͂͊́̈̾̈͌̊̾͆̉̅̄̆͌̏͐̚͝͝H̸̨̡̧̢̢̨͇͈̪̺̮̠̲̞̠͔̤̣̦̦͕̺͖̙̣̘̩͕̮̝͇̪̺̼͔̪̟͔͎̪̩͉͔͉͕͈̃͆̈́͑͑͌̕̕̕̕͜͜͠P̵̧̛͈̠̜̱̩̻̳̹̻͙͇̐̅̈́́͛̉̓̐̐͂̇̃́̋̀̂̃̄̓̊̂̊̔͆̿͊̉͘̚À̸͉͍̣̫̺̜͊̔͐̋̈́͗̈́̓̄̿̑͌͐̈́̓̎̇̀͗̅̍̒͌̇̽̕͘͘͘͝9̷̡̙͕͈͈̤͇̝̦̲̤͕̯͔̮̠̌́̉̎̌̇͊̒̆̒̓̈́͒̋͐̈́́̿̄̒̎̃̓͂̐͗̀͗̾̽̍̈́̓̍͛̿͛͘̚̕͝͠Ḙ̶̢̨̡̳͉̗̩͕͓͕̻͔͙̻̣̙̩̣̩̹͖̖̞̯͓͖̯͊̎͋͂̒̓̏̾̌̋͂̅̅̔̕͜͝ͅͅW̴̰͓̺͈͍̖͎̱͌̌̓̀̈́̇̋̌͌̿̏̃̄̔́͐͛̄̏́̓̀̈͒̉̀͋͌͐̔̀̃͂͘͝͝͠G̸̨̢̧̡̯̩̩̯̳͍̦̜͕̣̩̙͉̞͇͕̳̥̱̦͓̫͖̙̦̦̬̦̞̣͓̈͂̃̿̉̆̒͑̍̌̄8̵̢͍̰̍̃̾̃̅̒̽̌̀̄̓̒̌̌͊͑̏̅̑̈́̀͋̀̿̐͋̋̾́̍̐͆͐͘͝͝͝͝Ÿ̴̧̡̛̝͈̯͇̭̣̤̫̼́̌̐͆̃̌͑̃̇̿̑͋́͑̅̓̓̌̂͑̏̇̃̈́̔͘͘

Ạ̵̡̨̨̨̮̜̫̘̼̙͇͓̼̳͓͍̫̻͍̩͈̲̩̫̙̰͓͛̆̽̑͂͂̈́̄̒̔́̓̔̈́̓̎̅̏͜͜͜X̴̛̲͚̟͚̜̥̭̌̓̿̅̍̑̆͐̾̂̿̑̌̌̀̈́̍̽̈̒̋́̃̓̀̾̐͂́̚͘̕͘͝A̵̡͙͎̮͍͍͚̳͇̦̮̓̑̓͘͠͝ͅS̶̡̛̹̠̙̙̗̺̠̠̥̔̈̊͌̓̓̈́̃͐̐̋̾̋̾̀̉͒́͌̔͛̽͘̕͝F̷̡̢̺̱̼̲̼͙͚̥̪̝̙̱̩͙͍̝̹̲͍̗͚̮̩̻̲͙̩̼͛̍̈́̎̆̒͋̒̓̈̑͋͒̇̊́̑̇͆̂̔͛̎̈́͊̌̾̏̄̈́̔̇̏̈̿͑̉̂̍͌̕̕̕͘͜͜͝A̵̧̡̧̨̢̢̠̫̭͎̠̦̖͚̻̣̠͚͈̞̝̯̝͓̣͚͖̼͕̤̪̜͉̖̦̻͠S̸̛̩͔̺͓̥̈͌̒̀͑́̅̐̊͆͂͒͂̂̀̏̓̏̒̎̿̈́̅̍͗̅͗̂͆̍͒͘͘͠͝G̷̨̡̨̨̢̘̥̠̰̭̖̺̖̥̜̹̙͎̥̱͕̫̝̖̪̬̣̬̗̘͖͚̥͕̟͇͈͓̙̖͔̯̺̱̣̖͎͑͒̅̐͛̄́͗̿͛̍͐̒̍̓̂͌̔̈͑̏̽͑̎͛̈́̎̋̕͘̕͠͝͠͠ͅN̸̢̛̙̫̗̜͙̗͚͓̺̩̞̮̬̟͉̲͕̰͍̦̗̺͇͈̩̜̦͖̺͙͓͉̍̊̅̈̉̍̈́̄̒̾̓͗̔̌̐́̈̉̂̈̀̓̒͋̓̒̊̕̚̕̕͠A̸̢̨̧̢̡̢̡̛̛̛̛͉̤̟̪̯̱͈͉̖͕͓̺̦̘͖̱̻̖͔͎̼͉̩̫̝͓̯̙͖͎̤͙̫̬͈̘̾͑̽̀͊̌͑͑͒̿̄̀̏̈́̾́̔̈̃͂̒̿͂̐͑͂̌́̕̚͜͝͠ͅS̴͙̺̠̝̝̜͍̘̗̟̻͇̞̹̘̈́̾̎̋̽̈̀̇͆͒̏̄̈̽̆̑͆̂̽͆̇̾̎̽͗̋̑̕͝P̶̨̡̢̛̪̼̹͉̬̻͇͇͍͓̮̝̦̩̥̻̫̗̺͕̦̳̩̫̫̝̜̜̲̦̻̽̉̾͒͐̈̀͐͋̇̒̽̓̈́͛̐̑̔̆̂̉͑̓̅͋́̏̐̾̿͂̎̋̅͗̾̉̕͘̚͘̚͝͝͝͝ͅD̸̨̨̛͓͇̤̥̻̭͚̭͎̟͍͉̮̫̪̖̘͔͕̘̼̦̻̩̯̹͚̰͈̻̻͇̺͚͙͉͕̮͉̬̼̰̀͐̆͊̈́̌͗͑̈́̆̏͊̓̿̋̀̅̍̀͗̌̍͊̈̂͆̀̆̌̌̈̎̕̚͜͠͠͝͝ͅͅĨ̸̛̛̺͈̮͚͓̘̮̫͚͉̙̭̥͈̣̝̭̦̖̘̮̤̩͈̟̉̆̏́͂̆͒̑̂̔̋̍̌̎͗̒́̾̎̾̑̈̐͌͆͘͜͝͝Ṳ̶̡̢̡̻̺̦̯̥̪̳̭̯̺̻̗̪̞̻̰̜͓̯̥͓̩͍̲͙͕̞̜̪͕̃̉̊̓̓͂̍̊̓̓̄͐̽̀̔̒̀̆̉́̿̒͆͛͗͂̎͘͘͜͝͠͝͠͝ͅG̴̡̨̡̪͉̻̣͕̦͚̥̳̥̩̺̻̻͖̮̰̝̯̩͕͈̱̞̞͖͈̟̓̈́̋̕̚͝ͅͅḾ̷̧̨̛̩͇͉̹̲̤̰̪̝̩̗̳͎̳̟̣̰̘̬̼̠̺̯̖͒̓̄͂̋́̉̄͊̓̅̿̚͠ͅͅͅĂ̷̧̢̧̨̛͇̳͓͚̯͚̩̦͕̗͚̠͚͇̫͇͖̣̻̱̹̙̺̱̖̣͍͙͌̒̒́͒̒̈́̓͑͆̽̀͋̔͜͝S̶̨̙͖͉̻͍̣̦͍̭͔̜̘̖̹̊̌̀̈́́̈̔̒͒̃̾͛͐͘Ơ̸̡̨̡̧̝̳͍̲̘͍̲͚̥̭̼̬̳̙̥̠̝̠͖̹̪̞̬̟̩̟̹̩̝̬͆̿̔̆̐̃̾̏́̈́͒͆̃̐̐͗̃͑̓͗́͌̽̈́̆̅̀͐̕͝͝͝͝ͅ;̷̡̱͍̬̤͚̙̹̐̐̓̎̓́͑͗́̈̈́̎̒͊̾͒͆̌͑̓̃̓̈͑̈́̀͛̚͠͝ͅF̵̢̡̨̝̫͓̖̻͖̭͇̰̬̟͇̹̺̲̦̹̖̥͉̞̲͇͕̮͖͉̖̗̱͓͖͖͓̂̔͐̈́̍̂̏́͊͌̍̈́̋̋̈͐̆́̀̑̋̈́̏̏̀̅͆̿͌͗̐̆̿͐̐̇̕͜͝͠͠͠͝͠͝ͅK̷̡̨̢̢̡̨̨̛̰̙͓̜̲͔̲̞̼̹͈̘͈̙̜̱̫̫̰̜̻̙̼͇͍̥͎͖͔̤̪̉̑͌̾͑̅̂́̔̅͋̈́̈̐͒̎̒͑́̔̔̾̀̈́̈́̓͂̆͊̕͝͝͝͝͝͝ͅM̷͍̥̞͓͉͔͓̪̼̒͊͐͂̋̓̃̊̈́̓̄̐̂̾͌̑̉̇̐́̌͊̐͂̾͊̂̎͌͗͒̈̈́̈́̈́́̊͐̚̚͘͜͝͠͝͝Ą̶̧̢̧̛͖͎̮̦̱̤̫̿͛̍̏̐̈̽͛̀̉̚O̸̢̥̝̰͇̫̙͎͔̱̗̮̝̲̰͕̣̖̖̙͍̙̼͍̘͓̤͍͈͕͂͗͛̈́͌̍̆̎̊͛̐͋̓̃̀͝͠;̷̧̢̭̘͚̖̥̲̼͍̘̱̮͎͕͔̱̤̞̦͙̞̩̩͌̓͗̂̓͘͜͜Í̴̡̧̡̝̺̣̖̜̖̝̗͙͔͖͔̱͔̘̯̠͚͙̖̜͖͕̙̜̥͇̬̞͙̰̪̈́̾͒̓̈́́̑͒̽͊̑͊͂̌̃̈̽̂͌̀̊̔̋͋̒̎͆͘̚̕͘G̵̡̖͚͓̞̀͌̍̑̓̾̓̒̽̉͑͂͑̆̇̀̍͊̉̀̌̏̀́́̄́̉͐̇͗̚̚͝͠͝͝͝͝H̵̨̡͔̦̟̠̠̺͕̦̦͓̻͕̙̽̋͒͑̔̽̈͊̃̿̀̀͂̉̅̆̑̓̑̅̽͛̿̄͗̃̔͆̐̚͘͠͝D̸̡̡̢̛̛͚̝̠͓̠̟͖̳̞̺̳͇̤̩̝͈͓͙̖̗̟͖͕̹̖̥̰͔̭̖̳̘͚̰̪̫͉͓̞̩̬̾͗̓͑̈́͋͐̈̎͑̏͂͆̓̋̊͆̋̄́̅̇̕̕͜͝͝ͅL̶̥̘͔̲̝̩͔͕̬̜̪̖̪͙̥̃͒̿͐̓͒͆̃̉̈̃̃̄̚͝ͅÄ̸̡̛͉̥̤̣̦͕̦̞͍͖͈͙̭̯̯̙̗̰͍͚͕͚̣͎͓͙̥̗̹̬̙̹̙̻̯̠̙̳͕͙̦́̅̏̈́̿̂̏̇͘͜ͅͅS̷͖͖̪͕̖̩̳̘̋̌́̾̓̆͗̿͐̈́͛̄̈́̐̍͘̚͘̚Į̷̛̛̳̦̠̦̇̐́̒̌̇̽̏͋̽̂̎̈́̐͑̈̽̊̍̐̓́̿̔̋̍̉͂̑̑̓̚̚͠͝͠͝Ư̶̡̨̧̡̙̠̺̺̥̙̺͇̻̭̱͚̤̥̙̳̰̳̮̳̯͍͚͙̙̿͋̇̊͐̄̈͑̈̐̾͆̿͌̀̑̌̇̚͜͝͝͝ͅͅḠ̷̢̛̛̙̤̟̳͍͑̊̌̏̿̐̇́̈̐̃́̌͜͝͝ ̢̡̧̨̧̯̩͖̻̯͈̖̦̰̙͎̟͉͉͖̲̹̯͇͙̤̞͍̜͖̲̫͇̝̪̜̤̺̫̀̀̀͋̐̈́̓͛̿̒͂̋́̇̕͜Ǵ̴̛̬̻͙̯͙̓̍͒̀̽̈́̈̉̃̿̈́̆͛̊̌̀̇̀̀͐̑͂͊́̈̾̈͌̊̾͆̉̅̄̆͌̏͐̚͝͝H̸̨̡̧̢̢̨͇͈̪̺̮̠̲̞̠͔̤̣̦̦͕̺͖̙̣̘̩͕̮̝͇̪̺̼͔̪̟͔͎̪̩͉͔͉͕͈̃͆̈́͑͑͌̕̕̕̕͜͜͠P̵̧̛͈̠̜̱̩̻̳̹̻͙͇̐̅̈́́͛̉̓̐̐͂̇̃́̋̀̂̃̄̓̊̂̊̔͆̿͊̉͘̚À̸͉͍̣̫̺̜͊̔͐̋̈́͗̈́̓̄̿̑͌͐̈́̓̎̇̀͗̅̍̒͌̇̽̕͘͘͘͝9̷̡̙͕͈͈̤͇̝̦̲̤͕̯͔̮̠̌́̉̎̌̇͊̒̆̒̓̈́͒̋͐̈́́̿̄̒̎̃̓͂̐͗̀͗̾̽̍̈́̓̍͛̿͛͘̚̕͝͠Ḙ̶̢̨̡̳͉̗̩͕͓͕̻͔͙̻̣̙̩̣̩̹͖̖̞̯͓͖̯͊̎͋͂̒̓̏̾̌̋͂̅̅̔̕͜͝ͅͅW̴̰͓̺͈͍̖͎̱͌̌̓̀̈́̇̋̌͌̿̏̃̄̔́͐͛̄̏́̓̀̈͒̉̀͋͌͐̔̀̃͂͘͝͝͠G̸̨̢̧̡̯̩̩̯̳͍̦̜͕̣̩̙͉̞͇͕̳̥̱̦͓̫͖̙̦̦̬̦̞̣͓̈͂̃̿̉̆̒͑̍̌̄8̵̢͍̰̍̃̾̃̅̒̽̌̀̄̓̒̌̌͊͑̏̅̑̈́̀͋̀̿̐͋̋̾́̍̐͆͐͘͝͝͝͝Ÿ̴̧̡̛̝͈̯͇̭̣̤̫́̌̐͆̃̌͑̃̇̿̑͋́͑̅̓̓̌̂͑̏̇̃̈́̔͘͘

̡̡̢̢̡̡͙̤̰̼̭̼̟͍̳̙͉͇͍̦̞̜̙͕̤͔̝̠̭̣͓̫̺͍̝̝̺͈̯̘̙̹̬̈́̂͛̈́̈́̂͘͜ͅͅD̴̡͇͔̥̫͍̯͉̩͇̝͕͍̥̣͙͖̳̗̪̻̪̖̳̟̤̫̯̮͎͌͑̔͐͐̎̍̀̾̍̒̀̈̃̋́̂͝ͅF̸̡̧̧̢̛͇̪͔̹̠̫͚̭͇̘̩̲̼̬̺̹̥̣̜̭͙̭̣͚̳̪͍̟͉̹̖͚̺͙̙̼͈͕̻̑̽̓̋̈́̆̔̒̂̂͐̊̇̆̒̏̅̐̀̀̇̂̌͐͜͝͝͠͝͠͝ͅͅ[̶̡̧̨̧̛͉̼̞̻̪̞̘̰̘̝̝͍̬̬͖̜̘̖͖͈̫͍̻̦͉͙͕̫̻̙̲̭̺̗͚̞̱̰̝͋̀̈́͋̌̈́̈́̎̓̾̐̃̍̏͒̆̈̅̇̓͋͑̽̌͐̒̈́̄̍̉̏̂͗̒̍̆̏̾̾͑̾͘̚̕̚͜͜A̷̟̍͗̽̔̿͒̽̑̔͆̎̍̊̋̽̀̓̽̃͛̒̏̒̃́̅̈́̆̋̽̈́̾̾̉͋̃͋͐̓͒̈́̆͝͠0̶̢̧̛̥̤͚̩̭̳̌́̓̑̀́̀̋̑̎̓͋̉̈́͌́̉̇̐́̾̑̃̿̅̑̈́͋̄͒͛̑̀̚͘͜͝͠͝͝͝ͅS̶̡̛̛̛̼̞̣͓͇̜̗̣̹͍̙̟̘̲̠͉͉͚͇̰̦̩͓̣̹͉̥̮̙͎̝͉̯̯̗̻͚̹͈͕̊̉̃̿̈́̓͆̽̓̎̀͋̔͗̃́̓̾͂̔̍̌̓̏̎̉̀̈́͒͒͊͆͛́͒̃̕͘͘͜͜͜͝͝Í̶̧̨̡̛̛̯̦̫̳͎̰̱͕̗̝̠̬̭̞̻̱͓̬̪͔̘͚͖̼̝̲̜̯͓̩̣̽̈́̐̍̀̍̽̆̄́̔̍́͊̅̆̿̀̋̌̀̃͛̓̏̌͆̌̄̽̈́̔͘͜͠ͅJ̶̡̡̡͈̥͚͈̦̺̺̖̹̮̳̺͕͚̣̫͖̼͔̳̮̰̖̦͕̙̱̣̳͎̽̔̔͗̿̽͐̉̈́͆͒̓́̔͂̐͋̒̆̄͐̾̚̕̕͝ͅD̵̢̢̛̛̼̯̼͍̫͔̝̞̗͍͕̪͕̘͎̻̭̜͍̗̼̣͕̩̏̋̊̈́̂͆́̅̾͗̏͗̐̐͋̊̈́̑͌̊͂̈́́̅̅̒́̈́̾̊̔̓͌̌̇̒͐̎̀̚̕͘͝͝͝G̴̨̛͇̥͙̩̙͇̰͚͍̞̣̥̟̘̤͎̱͕͙͙͈̀͋̓̐̈́͒̋̈́̉̽̿́́̕̕͘͜͠͠͠P̵̢̨̧̧̨̛̬̳̞͍̯̩̟̳̱̫̳͖̳̹͕̣͙̥̲̦̟̣̗̊̑̆́͆̀̿́̌̋̑͆̾̽͗̀̈́͋̈͗́͐͗́̎͆̋́̄̏̉̓̋̏̚͜͜͠͝͝ͅͅ3̸͎͔̰̝̤͗̈́͑̿̒̅͊̓̐̿̓͂̅͑̋̐̂̈́́͐̃̽͌̓̐̈́́͋̆͑̽̏̂͝͝͝9̷̨̨̜̪̣͇̰̻̥̜̟̘̔̕͝4̶̡̢̧̨̪͇͔͚̼͎̘̫̬͓͖̱̜̪̞̫̹̳̲͔͉̲̻̣̩̠̱͕̖͇̰͔̲͎̞̎͐͛̉͋̃͆͌͆̏͑̽̄̓̒̄͒̈́̄̋̎͗̀͊̀̾͘͘͘͜͠͠ͅ8̷̨̱͎͉̻̖̹̰̹͕͍͔̘̝͎̜͈̖̟́̄́́̎͊̉͐̽̿̂̆̓̚͠G̸̰̲̩͓̗͙̜͋͛͜ͅḢ̸̨̡̡͉̼͖͍̺̦̭̲͉͖̦̖̲̮̞͈͇̬̙̳̘̎̈́̇̂̽̋̅̑̂̋̉̿͑͑̉̍̿̇͂̄͊̋̒́̉̕͘͜͜͠͝͝ͅ≠̡̧̡̧̨̛̛̛͇̗̲̫̝̲̟̼̹̠̟͎̠̻̬̼̝̱̅̔͐͐͊̍̄̇̾̃͐̒́̃̊̎̈́̐́̎͆̅̌̀̓́͗̃̈̈́́̐̐̃̒̍͊͊̈́͋̆̚͘͜͝[̴̧̧̨̛̛̼̣͉͇̫̳̹̖͕̬̥͚͈͖̺͈͍̙̥̬̮̖͇͙̟̝̺͔̲̹̬̗̥̹̮̲̟̯͉̖̤̎̔̋́̅̓̾̓͛͆̆͆̓͒͛̿͌̍͗̿̈́̋̕͜͠͠͝Ŗ̵̨̛͕͎͎̪̮̲̳͕̝͖̥̞̥͕͉̺͎̩̥͗̓̓̒̐̔̀̍̅̃͒̈̈͐̈́̔̑̓̚͝ͅA̷̧̡̗̞̪̰̦̺̥̼̳̪͔̓̓͌͑̿̌̈ͅḦ̷̪̣́̀̈́̎̋̂̄̈́͒͋͌̈́̋́̾́͗̍̀̏̈́̇͗͌̋̆͗̏̚͝͠͠J̷̛̛̝̲̣̣̠̠̉̿̍́͐͋̌̊̃͋̒̃̿̐̀̓̏̆͐̚͠\̶̡̡̧̧͚̤̣̯͚̱͇̻̙̪̺͎̦̠̞̫̱̪̤̰̩̩͈̗̙͓͍͔̊͑̓̐̾̓̈̌̈́̇͒͊͋̉͗̋̅̃̌̐̈́͒̄̐͛̏̿̅́̉͗̄̄̌͆̍̓̍̄̚̚͘͜͝͠͠͝͠͝ͅȘ̸̢̢̨̛̛͖̲̮͍̥̥̫̠̝̜̤̺̲͔̥̩͙͔͚̻̖͚̦͔̬͓̥̻̮͕̣͂͊̑̀͆̎̓̾̋̇͑̏̊͊̏̑́͛̈̍̊̓̂̈̐͑͋̀̂́͒̂̚̚̕͜͜͜͝͝ͅD̸̨̨̧̛͉̠͚̫̳͍̘̞͚͔̜̻͖͖̉̓̽̅͑̈́͒͂̓̎̎̍̈́̈́͆̾̐̓̔͛̍̑̕͝ͅV̸̧̡̧̢̤͖͎͎̖̩̲̮̣̘̦̥̤̫̫̲̘̩̳̤̹̝̠̤̗̹̻̻̼͉̝̖̥̲̮̳̗̲̂͗̐̓̊̐̏̾͐̂͛̇͛̈́̒̔̑̃̅̊̑̒̂͐̎̆̈́̏͐͑̑͂͌̑̈́̈́̊͆̂͒͂̽̍̕͘͜͜͝͝ͅȈ̸͖͈̞̉̀̎͌̈́̎̄̽̈́͆̀̐̀̎͠N̴̢̨̨̧͕̜̥̹̹̤̙̼̹͈͕̗̰͍͓̞̣͕̩̤̾̐̐̅̓͋͂̓͊́̀̍̉̌͒̑͌̽͑́͒̉̇͂̋̔̌̽̂̉̊̍̅̾͛̉̆̚̚͘͘̕̕̚͝͠͝͝P̴̧̨̛̛̰̤̤͔͔̱͚̩̜͕̪̬̖̱͓͔͕̦͋̀̐͑̇͒̐̄̇͑̈́͊̃͐̂͗̈̒̽́̏̍͂̓̋̃̍́͌̑̈́̈́̎̈́̊͘̚͘͜͜͝͝S̸̢̢̡̙̦̱̰̖̝͇͕͍̠̮̟̣̪̣̘̰͕̳͉͚̰̳͇̮̞̝̹̣̖̤̗̐̽̅̀̉͘ͅͅḐ̵̡̟̲͍͚̠̺̰͈͕̗̼͇̲̺͕̞̝̣̯͉̙̠̺̳͔̾̋̈̂́̾̓͑̇̋̌̆̀̈̀̋͌͘͠ͅÂ̵̢̧̢̧̢̨̡̛͙͙͈͈̫̹̮͍̲̩̼̪͙͖͚̦̠̯͇̪̰͖̜̹̮̗͇̘̲̖̣͙̮̦͈̩̲̽͋͐̀̇̈̐̃̊̓̉̉̂̚͘͜ͅͅU̵̧̪̞̩̳̻̖̥̿̎̃̀̈̋̽̃̂̋̆͛̔̓̓́̈́̈́͝͝͝I̶̢̡̧̨̧̯̩͖̻̯͈̖̦̰̙͎̟͉͉͖̲̹̯͇͙̤̞͍̜͖̲̫͇̝̪̜̤̺̫̊̅͑͆̌͊̀̒͗̀̉̋̋̒̊̍̈́̽͌̔̀̀̀͋̐̈́̓͛̿̒͂̋́̇̕͜Ǵ̴̛̬̻͙̯͙̓̍͒̀̽̈́̈̉̃̿̈́̆͛̊̌̀̇̀̀͐̑͂͊́̈̾̈͌̊̾͆̉̅̄̆͌̏͐̚͝͝H̸̨̡̧̢̢̨͇͈̪̺̮̠̲̞̠͔̤̣̦̦͕̺͖̙̣̘̩͕̮̝͇̪̺̼͔̪̟͔͎̪̩͉͔͉͕͈̃͆̈́͑͑͌̕̕̕̕͜͜͠P̵̧̛͈̠̜̱̩̻̳̹̻͙͇̐̅̈́́͛̉̓̐̐͂̇̃́̋̀̂̃̄̓̊̂̊̔͆̿͊̉͘̚À̸͉͍̣̫̺̜͊̔͐̋̈́͗̈́̓̄̿̑͌͐̈́̓̎̇̀͗̅̍̒͌̇̽̕͘͘͘͝9̷̡̙͕͈͈̤͇̝̦̲̤͕̯͔̮̠̌́̉̎̌̇͊̒̆̒̓̈́͒̋͐̈́́̿̄̒̎̃̓͂̐͗̀͗̾̽̍̈́̓̍͛̿͛͘̚̕͝͠Ḙ̶̢̨̡̳͉̗̩͕͓͕̻͔͙̻̣̙̩̣̩̹͖̖̞̯͓͖̯͊̎͋͂̒̓̏̾̌̋͂̅̅̔̕͜͝ͅͅW̴̰͓̺͈͍̖͎̱͌̌̓̀̈́̇̋̌͌̿̏̃̄̔́͐͛̄̏́̓̀̈͒̉̀͋͌͐̔̀̃͂͘͝͝͠G̸̨̢̧̡̯̩̩̯̳͍̦̜͕̣̩̙͉̞͇͕̳̥̱̦͓̫͖̙̦̦̬̦̞̣͓̈͂̃̿̉̆̒͑̍̌̄8̵̢͍̰̍̃̾̃̅̒̽̌̀̄̓̒̌̌͊͑̏̅̑̈́̀͋̀̿̐͋̋̾́̍̐͆͐͘͝͝͝͝Ÿ̴̧̡̛̝͈̯͇̭̣̤̫̼́̌̐͆̃̌͑̃̇̿̑͋́͑̅̓̓̌̂͑̏̇̃̈́̔͘͘




</p>
<br>
<br>
<p>For years I could not accept</p>
<p>the place I was in.</p>
<p>I felt I should be somewhere else.</p>
<p>A city, trees, human voices</p>
<p>lacked the quality of presence.</p>
<p>I would live by the hope of moving on.</p>
<p>Somewhere else there was a city of real presence, of real trees and voices and friendship and love.</p>
<br>

̢̡̧̨̧̯̩͖̻̯͈̖̦̰̙͎̟͉͉͖̲̹̯͇͙̤̞͍̜͖̲̫͇̝̪̜̤̺̫̀̀̀͋̐̈́̓͛̿̒͂̋́̇̕͜Ǵ̴̛̬̻͙̯͙̓̍͒̀̽̈́̈̉̃̿̈́̆͛̊̌̀̇̀̀͐̑͂͊́̈̾̈͌̊̾͆̉̅̄̆͌̏͐̚͝͝H̸̨̡̧̢̢̨͇͈̪̺̮̠̲̞̠͔̤̣̦̦͕̺͖̙̣̘̩͕̮̝͇̪̺̼͔̪̟͔͎̪̩͉͔͉͕͈̃͆̈́͑͑͌̕̕̕̕͜͜͠P̵̧̛͈̠̜̱̩̻̳̹̻͙͇̐̅̈́́͛̉̓̐̐͂̇̃́̋̀̂̃̄̓̊̂̊̔͆̿͊̉͘̚À̸͉͍̣̫̺̜͊̔͐̋̈́͗̈́̓̄̿̑͌͐̈́̓̎̇̀͗̅̍̒͌̇̽̕͘͘͘͝9̷̡̙͕͈͈̤͇̝̦̲̤͕̯͔̮̠̌́̉̎̌̇͊̒̆̒̓̈́͒̋͐̈́́̿̄̒̎̃̓͂̐͗̀͗̾̽̍̈́̓̍͛̿͛͘̚̕͝͠Ḙ̶̢̨̡̳͉̗̩͕͓͕̻͔͙̻̣̙̩̣̩̹͖̖̞̯͓͖̯͊̎͋͂̒̓̏̾̌̋͂̅̅̔̕͜͝ͅͅW̴̰͓̺͈͍̖͎̱͌̌̓̀̈́̇̋̌͌̿̏̃̄̔́͐͛̄̏́̓̀̈͒̉̀͋͌͐̔̀̃͂͘͝͝͠G̸̨̢̧̡̯̩̩̯̳͍̦̜͕̣̩̙͉̞͇͕̳̥̱̦͓̫͖̙̦̦̬̦̞̣͓̈͂̃̿̉̆̒͑̍̌̄8̵̢͍̰̍̃̾̃̅̒̽̌̀̄̓̒̌̌͊͑̏̅̑̈́̀͋̀̿̐͋̋̾́̍̐͆͐͘͝͝͝͝Ÿ̴̧̡̛̝͈̯͇̭̣̤̫́̌̐͆̃̌͑̃̇̿̑͋́͑̅̓̓̌̂͑̏̇̃̈́̔͘͘

Ạ̵̡̨̨̨̮̜̫̘̼̙͇͓̼̳͓͍̫̻͍̩͈̲̩̫̙̰͓͛̆̽̑͂͂̈́̄̒̔́̓̔̈́̓̎̅̏͜͜͜X̴̛̲͚̟͚̜̥̭̌̓̿̅̍̑̆͐̾̂̿̑̌̌̀̈́̍̽̈̒̋́̃̓̀̾̐͂́̚͘̕͘͝A̵̡͙͎̮͍͍͚̳͇̦̮̓̑̓͘͠͝ͅS̶̡̛̹̠̙̙̗̺̠̠̥̔̈̊͌̓̓̈́̃͐̐̋̾̋̾̀̉͒́͌̔͛̽͘̕͝F̷̡̢̺̱̼̲̼͙͚̥̪̝̙̱̩͙͍̝̹̲͍̗͚̮̩̻̲͙̩̼͛̍̈́̎̆̒͋̒̓̈̑͋͒̇̊́̑̇͆̂̔͛̎̈́͊̌̾̏̄̈́̔̇̏̈̿͑̉̂̍͌̕̕̕͘͜͜͝A̵̧̡̧̨̢̢̠̫̭͎̠̦̖͚̻̣̠͚͈̞̝̯̝͓̣͚͖̼͕̤̪̜͉̖̦̻͠S̸̛̩͔̺͓̥̈͌̒̀͑́̅̐̊͆͂͒͂̂̀̏̓̏̒̎̿̈́̅̍͗̅͗̂͆̍͒͘͘͠͝G̷̨̡̨̨̢̘̥̠̰̭̖̺̖̥̜̹̙͎̥̱͕̫̝̖̪̬̣̬̗̘͖͚̥͕̟͇͈͓̙̖͔̯̺̱̣̖͎͑͒̅̐͛̄́͗̿͛̍͐̒̍̓̂͌̔̈͑̏̽͑̎͛̈́̎̋̕͘̕͠͝͠͠ͅN̸̢̛̙̫̗̜͙̗͚͓̺̩̞̮̬̟͉̲͕̰͍̦̗̺͇͈̩̜̦͖̺͙͓͉̍̊̅̈̉̍̈́̄̒̾̓͗̔̌̐́̈̉̂̈̀̓̒͋̓̒̊̕̚̕̕͠A̸̢̨̧̢̡̢̡̛̛̛̛͉̤̟̪̯̱͈͉̖͕͓̺̦̘͖̱̻̖͔͎̼͉̩̫̝͓̯̙͖͎̤͙̫̬͈̘̾͑̽̀͊̌͑͑͒̿̄̀̏̈́̾́̔̈̃͂̒̿͂̐͑͂̌́̕̚͜͝͠ͅS̴͙̺̠̝̝̜͍̘̗̟̻͇̞̹̘̈́̾̎̋̽̈̀̇͆͒̏̄̈̽̆̑͆̂̽͆̇̾̎̽͗̋̑̕͝P̶̨̡̢̛̪̼̹͉̬̻͇͇͍͓̮̝̦̩̥̻̫̗̺͕̦̳̩̫̫̝̜̜̲̦̻̽̉̾͒͐̈̀͐͋̇̒̽̓̈́͛̐̑̔̆̂̉͑̓̅͋́̏̐̾̿͂̎̋̅͗̾̉̕͘̚͘̚͝͝͝͝ͅD̸̨̨̛͓͇̤̥̻̭͚̭͎̟͍͉̮̫̪̖̘͔͕̘̼̦̻̩̯̹͚̰͈̻̻͇̺͚͙͉͕̮͉̬̼̰̀͐̆͊̈́̌͗͑̈́̆̏͊̓̿̋̀̅̍̀͗̌̍͊̈̂͆̀̆̌̌̈̎̕̚͜͠͠͝͝ͅͅĨ̸̛̛̺͈̮͚͓̘̮̫͚͉̙̭̥͈̣̝̭̦̖̘̮̤̩͈̟̉̆̏́͂̆͒̑̂̔̋̍̌̎͗̒́̾̎̾̑̈̐͌͆͘͜͝͝Ṳ̶̡̢̡̻̺̦̯̥̪̳̭̯̺̻̗̪̞̻̰̜͓̯̥͓̩͍̲͙͕̞̜̪͕̃̉̊̓̓͂̍̊̓̓̄͐̽̀̔̒̀̆̉́̿̒͆͛͗͂̎͘͘͜͝͠͝͠͝ͅG̴̡̨̡̪͉̻̣͕̦͚̥̳̥̩̺̻̻͖̮̰̝̯̩͕͈̱̞̞͖͈̟̓̈́̋̕̚͝ͅͅḾ̷̧̨̛̩͇͉̹̲̤̰̪̝̩̗̳͎̳̟̣̰̘̬̼̠̺̯̖͒̓̄͂̋́̉̄͊̓̅̿̚͠ͅͅͅĂ̷̧̢̧̨̛͇̳͓͚̯͚̩̦͕̗͚̠͚͇̫͇͖̣̻̱̹̙̺̱̖̣͍͙͌̒̒́͒̒̈́̓͑͆̽̀͋̔͜͝S̶̨̙͖͉̻͍̣̦͍̭͔̜̘̖̹̊̌̀̈́́̈̔̒͒̃̾͛͐͘Ơ̸̡̨̡̧̝̳͍̲̘͍̲͚̥̭̼̬̳̙̥̠̝̠͖̹̪̞̬̟̩̟̹̩̝̬͆̿̔̆̐̃̾̏́̈́͒͆̃̐̐͗̃͑̓͗́͌̽̈́̆̅̀͐̕͝͝͝͝ͅ;̷̡̱͍̬̤͚̙̹̐̐̓̎̓́͑͗́̈̈́̎̒͊̾͒͆̌͑̓̃̓̈͑̈́̀͛̚͠͝ͅF̵̢̡̨̝̫͓̖̻͖̭͇̰̬̟͇̹̺̲̦̹̖̥͉̞̲͇͕̮͖͉̖̗̱͓͖͖͓̂̔͐̈́̍̂̏́͊͌̍̈́̋̋̈͐̆́̀̑̋̈́̏̏̀̅͆̿͌͗̐̆̿͐̐̇̕͜͝͠͠͠͝͠͝ͅK̷̡̨̢̢̡̨̨̛̰̙͓̜̲͔̲̞̼̹͈̘͈̙̜̱̫̫̰̜̻̙̼͇͍̥͎͖͔̤̪̉̑͌̾͑̅̂́̔̅͋̈́̈̐͒̎̒͑́̔̔̾̀̈́̈́̓͂̆͊̕͝͝͝͝͝͝ͅM̷͍̥̞͓͉͔͓̪̼̒͊͐͂̋̓̃̊̈́̓̄̐̂̾͌̑̉̇̐́̌͊̐͂̾͊̂̎͌͗͒̈̈́̈́̈́́̊͐̚̚͘͜͝͠͝͝Ą̶̧̢̧̛͖͎̮̦̱̤̫̿͛̍̏̐̈̽͛̀̉̚O̸̢̥̝̰͇̫̙͎͔̱̗̮̝̲̰͕̣̖̖̙͍̙̼͍̘͓̤͍͈͕͂͗͛̈́͌̍̆̎̊͛̐͋̓̃̀͝͠;̷̧̢̭̘͚̖̥̲̼͍̘̱̮͎͕͔̱̤̞̦͙̞̩̩͌̓͗̂̓͘͜͜Í̴̡̧̡̝̺̣̖̜̖̝̗͙͔͖͔̱͔̘̯̠͚͙̖̜͖͕̙̜̥͇̬̞͙̰̪̈́̾͒̓̈́́̑͒̽͊̑͊͂̌̃̈̽̂͌̀̊̔̋͋̒̎͆͘̚̕͘G̵̡̖͚͓̞̀͌̍̑̓̾̓̒̽̉͑͂͑̆̇̀̍͊̉̀̌̏̀́́̄́̉͐̇͗̚̚͝͠͝͝͝͝H̵̨̡͔̦̟̠̠̺͕̦̦͓̻͕̙̽̋͒͑̔̽̈͊̃̿̀̀͂̉̅̆̑̓̑̅̽͛̿̄͗̃̔͆̐̚͘͠͝D̸̡̡̢̛̛͚̝̠͓̠̟͖̳̞̺̳͇̤̩̝͈͓͙̖̗̟͖͕̹̖̥̰͔̭̖̳̘͚̰̪̫͉͓̞̩̬̾͗̓͑̈́͋͐̈̎͑̏͂͆̓̋̊͆̋̄́̅̇̕̕͜͝͝ͅL̶̥̘͔̲̝̩͔͕̬̜̪̖̪͙̥̃͒̿͐̓͒͆̃̉̈̃̃̄̚͝ͅÄ̸̡̛͉̥̤̣̦͕̦̞͍͖͈͙̭̯̯̙̗̰͍͚͕͚̣͎͓͙̥̗̹̬̙̹̙̻̯̠̙̳͕͙̦́̅̏̈́̿̂̏̇͘͜ͅͅS̷͖͖̪͕̖̩̳̘̋̌́̾̓̆͗̿͐̈́͛̄̈́̐̍͘̚͘̚Į̷̛̛̳̦̠̦̇̐́̒̌̇̽̏͋̽̂̎̈́̐͑̈̽̊̍̐̓́̿̔̋̍̉͂̑̑̓̚̚͠͝͠͝Ư̶̡̨̧̡̙̠̺̺̥̙̺͇̻̭̱͚̤̥̙̳̰̳̮̳̯͍͚͙̙̿͋̇̊͐̄̈͑̈̐̾͆̿͌̀̑̌̇̚͜͝͝͝ͅͅḠ̷̢̛̛̙̤̟̳͍͑̊̌̏̿̐̇́̈̐̃́̌͜͝͝ <p>i am cynical and rotten to my core and if i were to allow myself to release my tight grasp on my self for even a second all of it would pour out. the love that i seem to saturate the space around me with is a choice and an increasingly difficult one. i express this love not because i posses it or am capable or believe it should be given to the world but, more and more, as a kind of chess move, or maybe a leap of faith, that if i put more and more of it into the right crevices The Thing will be in there and everything i have lost to the world will finally be given back. i am sad and expressing love is how i am slowly killing myself</p>

Ạ̵̡̨̨̨̮̜̫̘̼̙͇͓̼̳͓͍̫̻͍̩͈̲̩̫̙̰͓͛̆̽̑͂͂̈́̄̒̔́̓̔̈́̓̎̅̏͜͜͜X̴̛̲͚̟͚̜̥̭̌̓̿̅̍̑̆͐̾̂̿̑̌̌̀̈́̍̽̈̒̋́̃̓̀̾̐͂́̚͘̕͘͝A̵̡͙͎̮͍͍͚̳͇̦̮̓̑̓͘͠͝ͅS̶̡̛̹̠̙̙̗̺̠̠̥̔̈̊͌̓̓̈́̃͐̐̋̾̋̾̀̉͒́͌̔͛̽͘̕͝F̷̡̢̺̱̼̲̼͙͚̥̪̝̙̱̩͙͍̝̹̲͍̗͚̮̩̻̲͙̩̼͛̍̈́̎̆̒͋̒̓̈̑͋͒̇̊́̑̇͆̂̔͛̎̈́͊̌̾̏̄̈́̔̇̏̈̿͑̉̂̍͌̕̕̕͘͜͜͝A̵̧̡̧̨̢̢̠̫̭͎̠̦̖͚̻̣̠͚͈̞̝̯̝͓̣͚͖̼͕̤̪̜͉̖̦̻͠S̸̛̩͔̺͓̥̈͌̒̀͑́̅̐̊͆͂͒͂̂̀̏̓̏̒̎̿̈́̅̍͗̅͗̂͆̍͒͘͘͠͝G̷̨̡̨̨̢̘̥̠̰̭̖̺̖̥̜̹̙͎̥̱͕̫̝̖̪̬̣̬̗̘͖͚̥͕̟͇͈͓̙̖͔̯̺̱̣̖͎͑͒̅̐͛̄́͗̿͛̍͐̒̍̓̂͌̔̈͑̏̽͑̎͛̈́̎̋̕͘̕͠͝͠͠ͅN̸̢̛̙̫̗̜͙̗͚͓̺̩̞̮̬̟͉̲͕̰͍̦̗̺͇͈̩̜̦͖̺͙͓͉̍̊̅̈̉̍̈́̄̒̾̓͗̔̌̐́̈̉̂̈̀̓̒͋̓̒̊̕̚̕̕͠A̸̢̨̧̢̡̢̡̛̛̛̛͉̤̟̪̯̱͈͉̖͕͓̺̦̘͖̱̻̖͔͎̼͉̩̫̝͓̯̙͖͎̤͙̫̬͈̘̾͑̽̀͊̌͑͑͒̿̄̀̏̈́̾́̔̈̃͂̒̿͂̐͑͂̌́̕̚͜͝͠ͅS̴͙̺̠̝̝̜͍̘̗̟̻͇̞̹̘̈́̾̎̋̽̈̀̇͆͒̏̄̈̽̆̑͆̂̽͆̇̾̎̽͗̋̑̕͝P̶̨̡̢̛̪̼̹͉̬̻͇͇͍͓̮̝̦̩̥̻̫̗̺͕̦̳̩̫̫̝̜̜̲̦̻̽̉̾͒͐̈̀͐͋̇̒̽̓̈́͛̐̑̔̆̂̉͑̓̅͋́̏̐̾̿͂̎̋̅͗̾̉̕͘̚͘̚͝͝͝͝ͅD̸̨̨̛͓͇̤̥̻̭͚̭͎̟͍͉̮̫̪̖̘͔͕̘̼̦̻̩̯̹͚̰͈̻̻͇̺͚͙͉͕̮͉̬̼̰̀͐̆͊̈́̌͗͑̈́̆̏͊̓̿̋̀̅̍̀͗̌̍͊̈̂͆̀̆̌̌̈̎̕̚͜͠͠͝͝ͅͅĨ̸̛̛̺͈̮͚͓̘̮̫͚͉̙̭̥͈̣̝̭̦̖̘̮̤̩͈̟̉̆̏́͂̆͒̑̂̔̋̍̌̎͗̒́̾̎̾̑̈̐͌͆͘͜͝͝Ṳ̶̡̢̡̻̺̦̯̥̪̳̭̯̺̻̗̪̞̻̰̜͓̯̥͓̩͍̲͙͕̞̜̪͕̃̉̊̓̓͂̍̊̓̓̄͐̽̀̔̒̀̆̉́̿̒͆͛͗͂̎͘͘͜͝͠͝͠͝ͅG̴̡̨̡̪͉̻̣͕̦͚̥̳̥̩̺̻̻͖̮̰̝̯̩͕͈̱̞̞͖͈̟̓̈́̋̕̚͝ͅͅḾ̷̧̨̛̩͇͉̹̲̤̰̪̝̩̗̳͎̳̟̣̰̘̬̼̠̺̯̖͒̓̄͂̋́̉̄͊̓̅̿̚͠ͅͅͅĂ̷̧̢̧̨̛͇̳͓͚̯͚̩̦͕̗͚̠͚͇̫͇͖̣̻̱̹̙̺̱̖̣͍͙͌̒̒́͒̒̈́̓͑͆̽̀͋̔͜͝S̶̨̙͖͉̻͍̣̦͍̭͔̜̘̖̹̊̌̀̈́́̈̔̒͒̃̾͛͐͘Ơ̸̡̨̡̧̝̳͍̲̘͍̲͚̥̭̼̬̳̙̥̠̝̠͖̹̪̞̬̟̩̟̹̩̝̬͆̿̔̆̐̃̾̏́̈́͒͆̃̐̐͗̃͑̓͗́͌̽̈́̆̅̀͐̕͝͝͝͝ͅ;̷̡̱͍̬̤͚̙̹̐̐̓̎̓́͑͗́̈̈́̎̒͊̾͒͆̌͑̓̃̓̈͑̈́̀͛̚͠͝ͅF̵̢̡̨̝̫͓̖̻͖̭͇̰̬̟͇̹̺̲̦̹̖̥͉̞̲͇͕̮͖͉̖̗̱͓͖͖͓̂̔͐̈́̍̂̏́͊͌̍̈́̋̋̈͐̆́̀̑̋̈́̏̏̀̅͆̿͌͗̐̆̿͐̐̇̕͜͝͠͠͠͝͠͝ͅK̷̡̨̢̢̡̨̨̛̰̙͓̜̲͔̲̞̼̹͈̘͈̙̜̱̫̫̰̜̻̙̼͇͍̥͎͖͔̤̪̉̑͌̾͑̅̂́̔̅͋̈́̈̐͒̎̒͑́̔̔̾̀̈́̈́̓͂̆͊̕͝͝͝͝͝͝ͅM̷͍̥̞͓͉͔͓̪̼̒͊͐͂̋̓̃̊̈́̓̄̐̂̾͌̑̉̇̐́̌͊̐͂̾͊̂̎͌͗͒̈̈́̈́̈́́̊͐̚̚͘͜͝͠͝͝Ą̶̧̢̧̛͖͎̮̦̱̤̫̿͛̍̏̐̈̽͛̀̉̚O̸̢̥̝̰͇̫̙͎͔̱̗̮̝̲̰͕̣̖̖̙͍̙̼͍̘͓̤͍͈͕͂͗͛̈́͌̍̆̎̊͛̐͋̓̃̀͝͠;̷̧̢̭̘͚̖̥̲̼͍̘̱̮͎͕͔̱̤̞̦͙̞̩̩͌̓͗̂̓͘͜͜Í̴̡̧̡̝̺̣̖̜̖̝̗͙͔͖͔̱͔̘̯̠͚͙̖̜͖͕̙̜̥͇̬̞͙̰̪̈́̾͒̓̈́́̑͒̽͊̑͊͂̌̃̈̽̂͌̀̊̔̋͋̒̎͆͘̚̕͘G̵̡̖͚͓̞̀͌̍̑̓̾̓̒̽̉͑͂͑̆̇̀̍͊̉̀̌̏̀́́̄́̉͐̇͗̚̚͝͠͝͝͝͝H̵̨̡͔̦̟̠̠̺͕̦̦͓̻͕̙̽̋͒͑̔̽̈͊̃̿̀̀͂̉̅̆̑̓̑̅̽͛̿̄͗̃̔͆̐̚͘͠͝D̸̡̡̢̛̛͚̝̠͓̠̟͖̳̞̺̳͇̤̩̝͈͓͙̖̗̟͖͕̹̖̥̰͔̭̖̳̘͚̰̪̫͉͓̞̩̬̾͗̓͑̈́͋͐̈̎͑̏͂͆̓̋̊͆̋̄́̅̇̕̕͜͝͝ͅL̶̥̘͔̲̝̩͔͕̬̜̪̖̪͙̥̃͒̿͐̓͒͆̃̉̈̃̃̄̚͝ͅÄ̸̡̛͉̥̤̣̦͕̦̞͍͖͈͙̭̯̯̙̗̰͍͚͕͚̣͎͓͙̥̗̹̬̙̹̙̻̯̠̙̳͕͙̦́̅̏̈́̿̂̏̇͘͜ͅͅS̷͖͖̪͕̖̩̳̘̋̌́̾̓̆͗̿͐̈́͛̄̈́̐̍͘̚͘̚Į̷̛̛̳̦̠̦̇̐́̒̌̇̽̏͋̽̂̎̈́̐͑̈̽̊̍̐̓́̿̔̋̍̉͂̑̑̓̚̚͠͝͠͝Ư̶̡̨̧̡̙̠̺̺̥̙̺͇̻̭̱͚̤̥̙̳̰̳̮̳̯͍͚͙̙̿͋̇̊͐̄̈͑̈̐̾͆̿͌̀̑̌̇̚͜͝͝͝ͅͅḠ̷̢̛̛̙̤̟̳͍͑̊̌̏̿̐̇́̈̐̃́̌͜͝͝ Ạ̵̡̨̨̨̮̜̫̘̼̙͇͓̼̳͓͍̫̻͍̩͈̲̩̫̙̰͓͛̆̽̑͂͂̈́̄̒̔́̓̔̈́̓̎̅̏͜͜͜X̴̛̲͚̟͚̜̥̭̌̓̿̅̍̑̆͐̾̂̿̑̌̌̀̈́̍̽̈̒̋́̃̓̀̾̐͂́̚͘̕͘͝A̵̡͙͎̮͍͍͚̳͇̦̮̓̑̓͘͠͝ͅS̶̡̛̹̠̙̙̗̺̠̠̥̔̈̊͌̓̓̈́̃͐̐̋̾̋̾̀̉͒́͌̔͛̽͘̕͝F̷̡̢̺̱̼̲̼͙͚̥̪̝̙̱̩͙͍̝̹̲͍̗͚̮̩̻̲͙̩̼͛̍̈́̎̆̒͋̒̓̈̑͋͒̇̊́̑̇͆̂̔͛̎̈́͊̌̾̏̄̈́̔̇̏̈̿͑̉̂̍͌̕̕̕͘͜͜͝A̵̧̡̧̨̢̢̠̫̭͎̠̦̖͚̻̣̠͚͈̞̝̯̝͓̣͚͖̼͕̤̪̜͉̖̦̻͠S̸̛̩͔̺͓̥̈͌̒̀͑́̅̐̊͆͂͒͂̂̀̏̓̏̒̎̿̈́̅̍͗̅͗̂͆̍͒͘͘͠͝G̷̨̡̨̨̢̘̥̠̰̭̖̺̖̥̜̹̙͎̥̱͕̫̝̖̪̬̣̬̗̘͖͚̥͕̟͇͈͓̙̖͔̯̺̱̣̖͎͑͒̅̐͛̄́͗̿͛̍͐̒̍̓̂͌̔̈͑̏̽͑̎͛̈́̎̋̕͘̕͠͝͠͠ͅN̸̢̛̙̫̗̜͙̗͚͓̺̩̞̮̬̟͉̲͕̰͍̦̗̺͇͈̩̜̦͖̺͙͓͉̍̊̅̈̉̍̈́̄̒̾̓͗̔̌̐́̈̉̂̈̀̓̒͋̓̒̊̕̚̕̕͠A̸̢̨̧̢̡̢̡̛̛̛̛͉̤̟̪̯̱͈͉̖͕͓̺̦̘͖̱̻̖͔͎̼͉̩̫̝͓̯̙͖͎̤͙̫̬͈̘̾͑̽̀͊̌͑͑͒̿̄̀̏̈́̾́̔̈̃͂̒̿͂̐͑͂̌́̕̚͜͝͠ͅS̴͙̺̠̝̝̜͍̘̗̟̻͇̞̹̘̈́̾̎̋̽̈̀̇͆͒̏̄̈̽̆̑͆̂̽͆̇̾̎̽͗̋̑̕͝P̶̨̡̢̛̪̼̹͉̬̻͇͇͍͓̮̝̦̩̥̻̫̗̺͕̦̳̩̫̫̝̜̜̲̦̻̽̉̾͒͐̈̀͐͋̇̒̽̓̈́͛̐̑̔̆̂̉͑̓̅͋́̏̐̾̿͂̎̋̅͗̾̉̕͘̚͘̚͝͝͝͝ͅD̸̨̨̛͓͇̤̥̻̭͚̭͎̟͍͉̮̫̪̖̘͔͕̘̼̦̻̩̯̹͚̰͈̻̻͇̺͚͙͉͕̮͉̬̼̰̀͐̆͊̈́̌͗͑̈́̆̏͊̓̿̋̀̅̍̀͗̌̍͊̈̂͆̀̆̌̌̈̎̕̚͜͠͠͝͝ͅͅĨ̸̛̛̺͈̮͚͓̘̮̫͚͉̙̭̥͈̣̝̭̦̖̘̮̤̩͈̟̉̆̏́͂̆͒̑̂̔̋̍̌̎͗̒́̾̎̾̑̈̐͌͆͘͜͝͝Ṳ̶̡̢̡̻̺̦̯̥̪̳̭̯̺̻̗̪̞̻̰̜͓̯̥͓̩͍̲͙͕̞̜̪͕̃̉̊̓̓͂̍̊̓̓̄͐̽̀̔̒̀̆̉́̿̒͆͛͗͂̎͘͘͜͝͠͝͠͝ͅG̴̡̨̡̪͉̻̣͕̦͚̥̳̥̩̺̻̻͖̮̰̝̯̩͕͈̱̞̞͖͈̟̓̈́̋̕̚͝ͅͅḾ̷̧̨̛̩͇͉̹̲̤̰̪̝̩̗̳͎̳̟̣̰̘̬̼̠̺̯̖͒̓̄͂̋́̉̄͊̓̅̿̚͠ͅͅͅĂ̷̧̢̧̨̛͇̳͓͚̯͚̩̦͕̗͚̠͚͇̫͇͖̣̻̱̹̙̺̱̖̣͍͙͌̒̒́͒̒̈́̓͑͆̽̀͋̔͜͝S̶̨̙͖͉̻͍̣̦͍̭͔̜̘̖̹̊̌̀̈́́̈̔̒͒̃̾͛͐͘Ơ̸̡̨̡̧̝̳͍̲̘͍̲͚̥̭̼̬̳̙̥̠̝̠͖̹̪̞̬̟̩̟̹̩̝̬͆̿̔̆̐̃̾̏́̈́͒͆̃̐̐͗̃͑̓͗́͌̽̈́̆̅̀͐̕͝͝͝͝ͅ;̷̡̱͍̬̤͚̙̹̐̐̓̎̓́͑͗́̈̈́̎̒͊̾͒͆̌͑̓̃̓̈͑̈́̀͛̚͠͝ͅF̵̢̡̨̝̫͓̖̻͖̭͇̰̬̟͇̹̺̲̦̹̖̥͉̞̲͇͕̮͖͉̖̗̱͓͖͖͓̂̔͐̈́̍̂̏́͊͌̍̈́̋̋̈͐̆́̀̑̋̈́̏̏̀̅͆̿͌͗̐̆̿͐̐̇̕͜͝͠͠͠͝͠͝ͅK̷̡̨̢̢̡̨̨̛̰̙͓̜̲͔̲̞̼̹͈̘͈̙̜̱̫̫̰̜̻̙̼͇͍̥͎͖͔̤̪̉̑͌̾͑̅̂́̔̅͋̈́̈̐͒̎̒͑́̔̔̾̀̈́̈́̓͂̆͊̕͝͝͝͝͝͝ͅM̷͍̥̞͓͉͔͓̪̼̒͊͐͂̋̓̃̊̈́̓̄̐̂̾͌̑̉̇̐́̌͊̐͂̾͊̂̎͌͗͒̈̈́̈́̈́́̊͐̚̚͘͜͝͠͝͝Ą̶̧̢̧̛͖͎̮̦̱̤̫̿͛̍̏̐̈̽͛̀̉̚O̸̢̥̝̰͇̫̙͎͔̱̗̮̝̲̰͕̣̖̖̙͍̙̼͍̘͓̤͍͈͕͂͗͛̈́͌̍̆̎̊͛̐͋̓̃̀͝͠;̷̧̢̭̘͚̖̥̲̼͍̘̱̮͎͕͔̱̤̞̦͙̞̩̩͌̓͗̂̓͘͜͜Í̴̡̧̡̝̺̣̖̜̖̝̗͙͔͖͔̱͔̘̯̠͚͙̖̜͖͕̙̜̥͇̬̞͙̰̪̈́̾͒̓̈́́̑͒̽͊̑͊͂̌̃̈̽̂͌̀̊̔̋͋̒̎͆͘̚̕͘G̵̡̖͚͓̞̀͌̍̑̓̾̓̒̽̉͑͂͑̆̇̀̍͊̉̀̌̏̀́́̄́̉͐̇͗̚̚͝͠͝͝͝͝H̵̨̡͔̦̟̠̠̺͕̦̦͓̻͕̙̽̋͒͑̔̽̈͊̃̿̀̀͂̉̅̆̑̓̑̅̽͛̿̄͗̃̔͆̐̚͘͠͝D̸̡̡̢̛̛͚̝̠͓̠̟͖̳̞̺̳͇̤̩̝͈͓͙̖̗̟͖͕̹̖̥̰͔̭̖̳̘͚̰̪̫͉͓̞̩̬̾͗̓͑̈́͋͐̈̎͑̏͂͆̓̋̊͆̋̄́̅̇̕̕͜͝͝ͅL̶̥̘͔̲̝̩͔͕̬̜̪̖̪͙̥̃͒̿͐̓͒͆̃̉̈̃̃̄̚͝ͅÄ̸̡̛͉̥̤̣̦͕̦̞͍͖͈͙̭̯̯̙̗̰͍͚͕͚̣͎͓͙̥̗̹̬̙̹̙̻̯̠̙̳͕͙̦́̅̏̈́̿̂̏̇͘͜ͅͅS̷͖͖̪͕̖̩̳̘̋̌́̾̓̆͗̿͐̈́͛̄̈́̐̍͘̚͘̚Į̷̛̛̳̦̠̦̇̐́̒̌̇̽̏͋̽̂̎̈́̐͑̈̽̊̍̐̓́̿̔̋̍̉͂̑̑̓̚̚͠͝͠͝Ư̶̡̨̧̡̙̠̺̺̥̙̺͇̻̭̱͚̤̥̙̳̰̳̮̳̯͍͚͙̙̿͋̇̊͐̄̈͑̈̐̾͆̿͌̀̑̌̇̚͜͝͝͝ͅͅḠ̷̢̛̛̙̤̟̳͍͑̊̌̏̿̐̇́̈̐̃́̌͜͝͝ ̢̡̧̨̧̯̩͖̻̯͈̖̦̰̙͎̟͉͉͖̲̹̯͇͙̤̞͍̜͖̲̫͇̝̪̜̤̺̫̀̀̀͋̐̈́̓͛̿̒͂̋́̇̕͜Ǵ̴̛̬̻͙̯͙̓̍͒̀̽̈́̈̉̃̿̈́̆͛̊̌̀̇̀̀͐̑͂͊́̈̾̈͌̊̾͆̉̅̄̆͌̏͐̚͝͝H̸̨̡̧̢̢̨͇͈̪̺̮̠̲̞̠͔̤̣̦̦͕̺͖̙̣̘̩͕̮̝͇̪̺̼͔̪̟͔͎̪̩͉͔͉͕͈̃͆̈́͑͑͌̕̕̕̕͜͜͠P̵̧̛͈̠̜̱̩̻̳̹̻͙͇̐̅̈́́͛̉̓̐̐͂̇̃́̋̀̂̃̄̓̊̂̊̔͆̿͊̉͘̚À̸͉͍̣̫̺̜͊̔͐̋̈́͗̈́̓̄̿̑͌͐̈́̓̎̇̀͗̅̍̒͌̇̽̕͘͘͘͝9̷̡̙͕͈͈̤͇̝̦̲̤͕̯͔̮̠̌́̉̎̌̇͊̒̆̒̓̈́͒̋͐̈́́̿̄̒̎̃̓͂̐͗̀͗̾̽̍̈́̓̍͛̿͛͘̚̕͝͠Ḙ̶̢̨̡̳͉̗̩͕͓͕̻͔͙̻̣̙̩̣̩̹͖̖̞̯͓͖̯͊̎͋͂̒̓̏̾̌̋͂̅̅̔̕͜͝ͅͅW̴̰͓̺͈͍̖͎̱͌̌̓̀̈́̇̋̌͌̿̏̃̄̔́͐͛̄̏́̓̀̈͒̉̀͋͌͐̔̀̃͂͘͝͝͠G̸̨̢̧̡̯̩̩̯̳͍̦̜͕̣̩̙͉̞͇͕̳̥̱̦͓̫͖̙̦̦̬̦̞̣͓̈͂̃̿̉̆̒͑̍̌̄8̵̢͍̰̍̃̾̃̅̒̽̌̀̄̓̒̌̌͊͑̏̅̑̈́̀͋̀̿̐͋̋̾́̍̐͆͐͘͝͝͝͝Ÿ̴̧̡̛̝͈̯͇̭̣̤̫̼́̌̐͆̃̌͑̃̇̿̑͋́͑̅̓̓̌̂͑̏̇̃̈́̔͘͘

</p>

<p>the only very real love in the world is a hollowed spectrum visible in every colliding orb of blood & dust. It goes without saying, but selfless love is infinitely transcendentally boundless. Brotherhood isn't the ocean or the archipelago; it's the basic building block of civilization. There is evil in the dark, there is innocence in the light, there is love in the presence of horror. you know the things you love the most but can't physically hold them all? holding them in your mind, deep in your gut, somewhere deep inside you can feel them leaking from? holding them like this, in these moments of brokenness, while you've held them all? holding them like this. She's like a woodpecker, she picks up the smallest sand & dust particles, burrowed her fingers into the crystals, to peer into their burning, to see their lode sparking bright. All muses are born with imperfect opposites, dormant. Generation after generation suffers, for "not the right sort of man" "the wrong kind of marriage" "the wrong sort of child" "the wrong person to wed in love!"</p>

Ạ̵̡̨̨̨̮̜̫̘̼̙͇͓̼̳͓͍̫̻͍̩͈̲̩̫̙̰͓͛̆̽̑͂͂̈́̄̒̔́̓̔̈́̓̎̅̏͜͜͜X̴̛̲͚̟͚̜̥̭̌̓̿̅̍̑̆͐̾̂̿̑̌̌̀̈́̍̽̈̒̋́̃̓̀̾̐͂́̚͘̕͘͝A̵̡͙͎̮͍͍͚̳͇̦̮̓̑̓͘͠͝ͅS̶̡̛̹̠̙̙̗̺̠̠̥̔̈̊͌̓̓̈́̃͐̐̋̾̋̾̀̉͒́͌̔͛̽͘̕͝F̷̡̢̺̱̼̲̼͙͚̥̪̝̙̱̩͙͍̝̹̲͍̗͚̮̩̻̲͙̩̼͛̍̈́̎̆̒͋̒̓̈̑͋͒̇̊́̑̇͆̂̔͛̎̈́͊̌̾̏̄̈́̔̇̏̈̿͑̉̂̍͌̕̕̕͘͜͜͝A̵̧̡̧̨̢̢̠̫̭͎̠̦̖͚̻̣̠͚͈̞̝̯̝͓̣͚͖̼͕̤̪̜͉̖̦̻͠S̸̛̩͔̺͓̥̈͌̒̀͑́̅̐̊͆͂͒͂̂̀̏̓̏̒̎̿̈́̅̍͗̅͗̂͆̍͒͘͘͠͝G̷̨̡̨̨̢̘̥̠̰̭̖̺̖̥̜̹̙͎̥̱͕̫̝̖̪̬̣̬̗̘͖͚̥͕̟͇͈͓̙̖͔̯̺̱̣̖͎͑͒̅̐͛̄́͗̿͛̍͐̒̍̓̂͌̔̈͑̏̽͑̎͛̈́̎̋̕͘̕͠͝͠͠ͅN̸̢̛̙̫̗̜͙̗͚͓̺̩̞̮̬̟͉̲͕̰͍̦̗̺͇͈̩̜̦͖̺͙͓͉̍̊̅̈̉̍̈́̄̒̾̓͗̔̌̐́̈̉̂̈̀̓̒͋̓̒̊̕̚̕̕͠A̸̢̨̧̢̡̢̡̛̛̛̛͉̤̟̪̯̱͈͉̖͕͓̺̦̘͖̱̻̖͔͎̼͉̩̫̝͓̯̙͖͎̤͙̫̬͈̘̾͑̽̀͊̌͑͑͒̿̄̀̏̈́̾́̔̈̃͂̒̿͂̐͑͂̌́̕̚͜͝͠ͅS̴͙̺̠̝̝̜͍̘̗̟̻͇̞̹̘̈́̾̎̋̽̈̀̇͆͒̏̄̈̽̆̑͆̂̽͆̇̾̎̽͗̋̑̕͝P̶̨̡̢̛̪̼̹͉̬̻͇͇͍͓̮̝̦̩̥̻̫̗̺͕̦̳̩̫̫̝̜̜̲̦̻̽̉̾͒͐̈̀͐͋̇̒̽̓̈́͛̐̑̔̆̂̉͑̓̅͋́̏̐̾̿͂̎̋̅͗̾̉̕͘̚͘̚͝͝͝͝ͅD̸̨̨̛͓͇̤̥̻̭͚̭͎̟͍͉̮̫̪̖̘͔͕̘̼̦̻̩̯̹͚̰͈̻̻͇̺͚͙͉͕̮͉̬̼̰̀͐̆͊̈́̌͗͑̈́̆̏͊̓̿̋̀̅̍̀͗̌̍͊̈̂͆̀̆̌̌̈̎̕̚͜͠͠͝͝ͅͅĨ̸̛̛̺͈̮͚͓̘̮̫͚͉̙̭̥͈̣̝̭̦̖̘̮̤̩͈̟̉̆̏́͂̆͒̑̂̔̋̍̌̎͗̒́̾̎̾̑̈̐͌͆͘͜͝͝Ṳ̶̡̢̡̻̺̦̯̥̪̳̭̯̺̻̗̪̞̻̰̜͓̯̥͓̩͍̲͙͕̞̜̪͕̃̉̊̓̓͂̍̊̓̓̄͐̽̀̔̒̀̆̉́̿̒͆͛͗͂̎͘͘͜͝͠͝͠͝ͅG̴̡̨̡̪͉̻̣͕̦͚̥̳̥̩̺̻̻͖̮̰̝̯̩͕͈̱̞̞͖͈̟̓̈́̋̕̚͝ͅͅḾ̷̧̨̛̩͇͉̹̲̤̰̪̝̩̗̳͎̳̟̣̰̘̬̼̠̺̯̖͒̓̄͂̋́̉̄͊̓̅̿̚͠ͅͅͅĂ̷̧̢̧̨̛͇̳͓͚̯͚̩̦͕̗͚̠͚͇̫͇͖̣̻̱̹̙̺̱̖̣͍͙͌̒̒́͒̒̈́̓͑͆̽̀͋̔͜͝S̶̨̙͖͉̻͍̣̦͍̭͔̜̘̖̹̊̌̀̈́́̈̔̒͒̃̾͛͐͘Ơ̸̡̨̡̧̝̳͍̲̘͍̲͚̥̭̼̬̳̙̥̠̝̠͖̹̪̞̬̟̩̟̹̩̝̬͆̿̔̆̐̃̾̏́̈́͒͆̃̐̐͗̃͑̓͗́͌̽̈́̆̅̀͐̕͝͝͝͝ͅ;̷̡̱͍̬̤͚̙̹̐̐̓̎̓́͑͗́̈̈́̎̒͊̾͒͆̌͑̓̃̓̈͑̈́̀͛̚͠͝ͅF̵̢̡̨̝̫͓̖̻͖̭͇̰̬̟͇̹̺̲̦̹̖̥͉̞̲͇͕̮͖͉̖̗̱͓͖͖͓̂̔͐̈́̍̂̏́͊͌̍̈́̋̋̈͐̆́̀̑̋̈́̏̏̀̅͆̿͌͗̐̆̿͐̐̇̕͜͝͠͠͠͝͠͝ͅK̷̡̨̢̢̡̨̨̛̰̙͓̜̲͔̲̞̼̹͈̘͈̙̜̱̫̫̰̜̻̙̼͇͍̥͎͖͔̤̪̉̑͌̾͑̅̂́̔̅͋̈́̈̐͒̎̒͑́̔̔̾̀̈́̈́̓͂̆͊̕͝͝͝͝͝͝ͅM̷͍̥̞͓͉͔͓̪̼̒͊͐͂̋̓̃̊̈́̓̄̐̂̾͌̑̉̇̐́̌͊̐͂̾͊̂̎͌͗͒̈̈́̈́̈́́̊͐̚̚͘͜͝͠͝͝Ą̶̧̢̧̛͖͎̮̦̱̤̫̿͛̍̏̐̈̽͛̀̉̚O̸̢̥̝̰͇̫̙͎͔̱̗̮̝̲̰͕̣̖̖̙͍̙̼͍̘͓̤͍͈͕͂͗͛̈́͌̍̆̎̊͛̐͋̓̃̀͝͠;̷̧̢̭̘͚̖̥̲̼͍̘̱̮͎͕͔̱̤̞̦͙̞̩̩͌̓͗̂̓͘͜͜Í̴̡̧̡̝̺̣̖̜̖̝̗͙͔͖͔̱͔̘̯̠͚͙̖̜͖͕̙̜̥͇̬̞͙̰̪̈́̾͒̓̈́́̑͒̽͊̑͊͂̌̃̈̽̂͌̀̊̔̋͋̒̎͆͘̚̕͘G̵̡̖͚͓̞̀͌̍̑̓̾̓̒̽̉͑͂͑̆̇̀̍͊̉̀̌̏̀́́̄́̉͐̇͗̚̚͝͠͝͝͝͝H̵̨̡͔̦̟̠̠̺͕̦̦͓̻͕̙̽̋͒͑̔̽̈͊̃̿̀̀͂̉̅̆̑̓̑̅̽͛̿̄͗̃̔͆̐̚͘͠͝D̸̡̡̢̛̛͚̝̠͓̠̟͖̳̞̺̳͇̤̩̝͈͓͙̖̗̟͖͕̹̖̥̰͔̭̖̳̘͚̰̪̫͉͓̞̩̬̾͗̓͑̈́͋͐̈̎͑̏͂͆̓̋̊͆̋̄́̅̇̕̕͜͝͝ͅL̶̥̘͔̲̝̩͔͕̬̜̪̖̪͙̥̃͒̿͐̓͒͆̃̉̈̃̃̄̚͝ͅÄ̸̡̛͉̥̤̣̦͕̦̞͍͖͈͙̭̯̯̙̗̰͍͚͕͚̣͎͓͙̥̗̹̬̙̹̙̻̯̠̙̳͕͙̦́̅̏̈́̿̂̏̇͘͜ͅͅS̷͖͖̪͕̖̩̳̘̋̌́̾̓̆͗̿͐̈́͛̄̈́̐̍͘̚͘̚Į̷̛̛̳̦̠̦̇̐́̒̌̇̽̏͋̽̂̎̈́̐͑̈̽̊̍̐̓́̿̔̋̍̉͂̑̑̓̚̚͠͝͠͝Ư̶̡̨̧̡̙̠̺̺̥̙̺͇̻̭̱͚̤̥̙̳̰̳̮̳̯͍͚͙̙̿͋̇̊͐̄̈͑̈̐̾͆̿͌̀̑̌̇̚͜͝͝͝ͅͅḠ̷̢̛̛̙̤̟̳͍͑̊̌̏̿̐̇́̈̐̃́̌͜͝͝ ̢̡̧̨̧̯̩͖̻̯͈̖̦̰̙͎̟͉͉͖̲̹̯͇͙̤̞͍̜͖̲̫͇̝̪̜̤̺̫̀̀̀͋̐̈́̓͛̿̒͂̋́̇̕͜Ǵ̴̛̬̻͙̯͙̓̍͒̀̽̈́̈̉̃̿̈́̆͛̊̌̀̇̀̀͐̑͂͊́̈̾̈͌̊̾͆̉̅̄̆͌̏͐̚͝͝H̸̨̡̧̢̢̨͇͈̪̺̮̠̲̞̠͔̤̣̦̦͕̺͖̙̣̘̩͕̮̝͇̪̺̼͔̪̟͔͎̪̩͉͔͉͕͈̃͆̈́͑͑͌̕̕̕̕͜͜͠P̵̧̛͈̠̜̱̩̻̳̹̻͙͇̐̅̈́́͛̉̓̐̐͂̇̃́̋̀̂̃̄̓̊̂̊̔͆̿͊̉͘̚À̸͉͍̣̫̺̜͊̔͐̋̈́͗̈́̓̄̿̑͌͐̈́̓̎̇̀͗̅̍̒͌̇̽̕͘͘͘͝9̷̡̙͕͈͈̤͇̝̦̲̤͕̯͔̮̠̌́̉̎̌̇͊̒̆̒̓̈́͒̋͐̈́́̿̄̒̎̃̓͂̐͗̀͗̾̽̍̈́̓̍͛̿͛͘̚̕͝͠Ḙ̶̢̨̡̳͉̗̩͕͓͕̻͔͙̻̣̙̩̣̩̹͖̖̞̯͓͖̯͊̎͋͂̒̓̏̾̌̋͂̅̅̔̕͜͝ͅͅW̴̰͓̺͈͍̖͎̱͌̌̓̀̈́̇̋̌͌̿̏̃̄̔́͐͛̄̏́̓̀̈͒̉̀͋͌͐̔̀̃͂͘͝͝͠G̸̨̢̧̡̯̩̩̯̳͍̦̜͕̣̩̙͉̞͇͕̳̥̱̦͓̫͖̙̦̦̬̦̞̣͓̈͂̃̿̉̆̒͑̍̌̄8̵̢͍̰̍̃̾̃̅̒̽̌̀̄̓̒̌̌͊͑̏̅̑̈́̀͋̀̿̐͋̋̾́̍̐͆͐͘͝͝͝͝Ÿ̴̧̡̛̝͈̯͇̭̣̤̫̼́̌̐͆̃̌͑̃̇̿̑͋́͑̅̓̓̌̂͑̏̇̃̈́̔͘͘

Ạ̵̡̨̨̨̮̜̫̘̼̙͇͓̼̳͓͍̫̻͍̩͈̲̩̫̙̰͓͛̆̽̑͂͂̈́̄̒̔́̓̔̈́̓̎̅̏͜͜͜X̴̛̲͚̟͚̜̥̭̌̓̿̅̍̑̆͐̾̂̿̑̌̌̀̈́̍̽̈̒̋́̃̓̀̾̐͂́̚͘̕͘͝A̵̡͙͎̮͍͍͚̳͇̦̮̓̑̓͘͠͝ͅS̶̡̛̹̠̙̙̗̺̠̠̥̔̈̊͌̓̓̈́̃͐̐̋̾̋̾̀̉͒́͌̔͛̽͘̕͝F̷̡̢̺̱̼̲̼͙͚̥̪̝̙̱̩͙͍̝̹̲͍̗͚̮̩̻̲͙̩̼͛̍̈́̎̆̒͋̒̓̈̑͋͒̇̊́̑̇͆̂̔͛̎̈́͊̌̾̏̄̈́̔̇̏̈̿͑̉̂̍͌̕̕̕͘͜͜͝A̵̧̡̧̨̢̢̠̫̭͎̠̦̖͚̻̣̠͚͈̞̝̯̝͓̣͚͖̼͕̤̪̜͉̖̦̻͠S̸̛̩͔̺͓̥̈͌̒̀͑́̅̐̊͆͂͒͂̂̀̏̓̏̒̎̿̈́̅̍͗̅͗̂͆̍͒͘͘͠͝G̷̨̡̨̨̢̘̥̠̰̭̖̺̖̥̜̹̙͎̥̱͕̫̝̖̪̬̣̬̗̘͖͚̥͕̟͇͈͓̙̖͔̯̺̱̣̖͎͑͒̅̐͛̄́͗̿͛̍͐̒̍̓̂͌̔̈͑̏̽͑̎͛̈́̎̋̕͘̕͠͝͠͠ͅN̸̢̛̙̫̗̜͙̗͚͓̺̩̞̮̬̟͉̲͕̰͍̦̗̺͇͈̩̜̦͖̺͙͓͉̍̊̅̈̉̍̈́̄̒̾̓͗̔̌̐́̈̉̂̈̀̓̒͋̓̒̊̕̚̕̕͠A̸̢̨̧̢̡̢̡̛̛̛̛͉̤̟̪̯̱͈͉̖͕͓̺̦̘͖̱̻̖͔͎̼͉̩̫̝͓̯̙͖͎̤͙̫̬͈̘̾͑̽̀͊̌͑͑͒̿̄̀̏̈́̾́̔̈̃͂̒̿͂̐͑͂̌́̕̚͜͝͠ͅS̴͙̺̠̝̝̜͍̘̗̟̻͇̞̹̘̈́̾̎̋̽̈̀̇͆͒̏̄̈̽̆̑͆̂̽͆̇̾̎̽͗̋̑̕͝P̶̨̡̢̛̪̼̹͉̬̻͇͇͍͓̮̝̦̩̥̻̫̗̺͕̦̳̩̫̫̝̜̜̲̦̻̽̉̾͒͐̈̀͐͋̇̒̽̓̈́͛̐̑̔̆̂̉͑̓̅͋́̏̐̾̿͂̎̋̅͗̾̉̕͘̚͘̚͝͝͝͝ͅD̸̨̨̛͓͇̤̥̻̭͚̭͎̟͍͉̮̫̪̖̘͔͕̘̼̦̻̩̯̹͚̰͈̻̻͇̺͚͙͉͕̮͉̬̼̰̀͐̆͊̈́̌͗͑̈́̆̏͊̓̿̋̀̅̍̀͗̌̍͊̈̂͆̀̆̌̌̈̎̕̚͜͠͠͝͝ͅͅĨ̸̛̛̺͈̮͚͓̘̮̫͚͉̙̭̥͈̣̝̭̦̖̘̮̤̩͈̟̉̆̏́͂̆͒̑̂̔̋̍̌̎͗̒́̾̎̾̑̈̐͌͆͘͜͝͝Ṳ̶̡̢̡̻̺̦̯̥̪̳̭̯̺̻̗̪̞̻̰̜͓̯̥͓̩͍̲͙͕̞̜̪͕̃̉̊̓̓͂̍̊̓̓̄͐̽̀̔̒̀̆̉́̿̒͆͛͗͂̎͘͘͜͝͠͝͠͝ͅG̴̡̨̡̪͉̻̣͕̦͚̥̳̥̩̺̻̻͖̮̰̝̯̩͕͈̱̞̞͖͈̟̓̈́̋̕̚͝ͅͅḾ̷̧̨̛̩͇͉̹̲̤̰̪̝̩̗̳͎̳̟̣̰̘̬̼̠̺̯̖͒̓̄͂̋́̉̄͊̓̅̿̚͠ͅͅͅĂ̷̧̢̧̨̛͇̳͓͚̯͚̩̦͕̗͚̠͚͇̫͇͖̣̻̱̹̙̺̱̖̣͍͙͌̒̒́͒̒̈́̓͑͆̽̀͋̔͜͝S̶̨̙͖͉̻͍̣̦͍̭͔̜̘̖̹̊̌̀̈́́̈̔̒͒̃̾͛͐͘Ơ̸̡̨̡̧̝̳͍̲̘͍̲͚̥̭̼̬̳̙̥̠̝̠͖̹̪̞̬̟̩̟̹̩̝̬͆̿̔̆̐̃̾̏́̈́͒͆̃̐̐͗̃͑̓͗́͌̽̈́̆̅̀͐̕͝͝͝͝ͅ;̷̡̱͍̬̤͚̙̹̐̐̓̎̓́͑͗́̈̈́̎̒͊̾͒͆̌͑̓̃̓̈͑̈́̀͛̚͠͝ͅF̵̢̡̨̝̫͓̖̻͖̭͇̰̬̟͇̹̺̲̦̹̖̥͉̞̲͇͕̮͖͉̖̗̱͓͖͖͓̂̔͐̈́̍̂̏́͊͌̍̈́̋̋̈͐̆́̀̑̋̈́̏̏̀̅͆̿͌͗̐̆̿͐̐̇̕͜͝͠͠͠͝͠͝ͅK̷̡̨̢̢̡̨̨̛̰̙͓̜̲͔̲̞̼̹͈̘͈̙̜̱̫̫̰̜̻̙̼͇͍̥͎͖͔̤̪̉̑͌̾͑̅̂́̔̅͋̈́̈̐͒̎̒͑́̔̔̾̀̈́̈́̓͂̆͊̕͝͝͝͝͝͝ͅM̷͍̥̞͓͉͔͓̪̼̒͊͐͂̋̓̃̊̈́̓̄̐̂̾͌̑̉̇̐́̌͊̐͂̾͊̂̎͌͗͒̈̈́̈́̈́́̊͐̚̚͘͜͝͠͝͝Ą̶̧̢̧̛͖͎̮̦̱̤̫̿͛̍̏̐̈̽͛̀̉̚O̸̢̥̝̰͇̫̙͎͔̱̗̮̝̲̰͕̣̖̖̙͍̙̼͍̘͓̤͍͈͕͂͗͛̈́͌̍̆̎̊͛̐͋̓̃̀͝͠;̷̧̢̭̘͚̖̥̲̼͍̘̱̮͎͕͔̱̤̞̦͙̞̩̩͌̓͗̂̓͘͜͜Í̴̡̧̡̝̺̣̖̜̖̝̗͙͔͖͔̱͔̘̯̠͚͙̖̜͖͕̙̜̥͇̬̞͙̰̪̈́̾͒̓̈́́̑͒̽͊̑͊͂̌̃̈̽̂͌̀̊̔̋͋̒̎͆͘̚̕͘G̵̡̖͚͓̞̀͌̍̑̓̾̓̒̽̉͑͂͑̆̇̀̍͊̉̀̌̏̀́́̄́̉͐̇͗̚̚͝͠͝͝͝͝H̵̨̡͔̦̟̠̠̺͕̦̦͓̻͕̙̽̋͒͑̔̽̈͊̃̿̀̀͂̉̅̆̑̓̑̅̽͛̿̄͗̃̔͆̐̚͘͠͝D̸̡̡̢̛̛͚̝̠͓̠̟͖̳̞̺̳͇̤̩̝͈͓͙̖̗̟͖͕̹̖̥̰͔̭̖̳̘͚̰̪̫͉͓̞̩̬̾͗̓͑̈́͋͐̈̎͑̏͂͆̓̋̊͆̋̄́̅̇̕̕͜͝͝ͅL̶̥̘͔̲̝̩͔͕̬̜̪̖̪͙̥̃͒̿͐̓͒͆̃̉̈̃̃̄̚͝ͅÄ̸̡̛͉̥̤̣̦͕̦̞͍͖͈͙̭̯̯̙̗̰͍͚͕͚̣͎͓͙̥̗̹̬̙̹̙̻̯̠̙̳͕͙̦́̅̏̈́̿̂̏̇͘͜ͅͅS̷͖͖̪͕̖̩̳̘̋̌́̾̓̆͗̿͐̈́͛̄̈́̐̍͘̚͘̚Į̷̛̛̳̦̠̦̇̐́̒̌̇̽̏͋̽̂̎̈́̐͑̈̽̊̍̐̓́̿̔̋̍̉͂̑̑̓̚̚͠͝͠͝Ư̶̡̨̧̡̙̠̺̺̥̙̺͇̻̭̱͚̤̥̙̳̰̳̮̳̯͍͚͙̙̿͋̇̊͐̄̈͑̈̐̾͆̿͌̀̑̌̇̚͜͝͝͝ͅͅḠ̷̢̛̛̙̤̟̳͍͑̊̌̏̿̐̇́̈̐̃́̌͜͝͝ ̢̡̧̨̧̯̩͖̻̯͈̖̦̰̙͎̟͉͉͖̲̹̯͇͙̤̞͍̜͖̲̫͇̝̪̜̤̺̫̀̀̀͋̐̈́̓͛̿̒͂̋́̇̕͜Ǵ̴̛̬̻͙̯͙̓̍͒̀̽̈́̈̉̃̿̈́̆͛̊̌̀̇̀̀͐̑͂͊́̈̾̈͌̊̾͆̉̅̄̆͌̏͐̚͝͝H̸̨̡̧̢̢̨͇͈̪̺̮̠̲̞̠͔̤̣̦̦͕̺͖̙̣̘̩͕̮̝͇̪̺̼͔̪̟͔͎̪̩͉͔͉͕͈̃͆̈́͑͑͌̕̕̕̕͜͜͠P̵̧̛͈̠̜̱̩̻̳̹̻͙͇̐̅̈́́͛̉̓̐̐͂̇̃́̋̀̂̃̄̓̊̂̊̔͆̿͊̉͘̚À̸͉͍̣̫̺̜͊̔͐̋̈́͗̈́̓̄̿̑͌͐̈́̓̎̇̀͗̅̍̒͌̇̽̕͘͘͘͝9̷̡̙͕͈͈̤͇̝̦̲̤͕̯͔̮̠̌́̉̎̌̇͊̒̆̒̓̈́͒̋͐̈́́̿̄̒̎̃̓͂̐͗̀͗̾̽̍̈́̓̍͛̿͛͘̚̕͝͠Ḙ̶̢̨̡̳͉̗̩͕͓͕̻͔͙̻̣̙̩̣̩̹͖̖̞̯͓͖̯͊̎͋͂̒̓̏̾̌̋͂̅̅̔̕͜͝ͅͅW̴̰͓̺͈͍̖͎̱͌̌̓̀̈́̇̋̌͌̿̏̃̄̔́͐͛̄̏́̓̀̈͒̉̀͋͌͐̔̀̃͂͘͝͝͠G̸̨̢̧̡̯̩̩̯̳͍̦̜͕̣̩̙͉̞͇͕̳̥̱̦͓̫͖̙̦̦̬̦̞̣͓̈͂̃̿̉̆̒͑̍̌̄8̵̢͍̰̍̃̾̃̅̒̽̌̀̄̓̒̌̌͊͑̏̅̑̈́̀͋̀̿̐͋̋̾́̍̐͆͐͘͝͝͝͝Ÿ̴̧̡̛̝͈̯͇̭̣̤̫̼́̌̐͆̃̌͑̃̇̿̑͋́͑̅̓̓̌̂͑̏̇̃̈́̔͘͘

Ạ̵̡̨̨̨̮̜̫̘̼̙͇͓̼̳͓͍̫̻͍̩͈̲̩̫̙̰͓͛̆̽̑͂͂̈́̄̒̔́̓̔̈́̓̎̅̏͜͜͜X̴̛̲͚̟͚̜̥̭̌̓̿̅̍̑̆͐̾̂̿̑̌̌̀̈́̍̽̈̒̋́̃̓̀̾̐͂́̚͘̕͘͝A̵̡͙͎̮͍͍͚̳͇̦̮̓̑̓͘͠͝ͅS̶̡̛̹̠̙̙̗̺̠̠̥̔̈̊͌̓̓̈́̃͐̐̋̾̋̾̀̉͒́͌̔͛̽͘̕͝F̷̡̢̺̱̼̲̼͙͚̥̪̝̙̱̩͙͍̝̹̲͍̗͚̮̩̻̲͙̩̼͛̍̈́̎̆̒͋̒̓̈̑͋͒̇̊́̑̇͆̂̔͛̎̈́͊̌̾̏̄̈́̔̇̏̈̿͑̉̂̍͌̕̕̕͘͜͜͝A̵̧̡̧̨̢̢̠̫̭͎̠̦̖͚̻̣̠͚͈̞̝̯̝͓̣͚͖̼͕̤̪̜͉̖̦̻͠S̸̛̩͔̺͓̥̈͌̒̀͑́̅̐̊͆͂͒͂̂̀̏̓̏̒̎̿̈́̅̍͗̅͗̂͆̍͒͘͘͠͝G̷̨̡̨̨̢̘̥̠̰̭̖̺̖̥̜̹̙͎̥̱͕̫̝̖̪̬̣̬̗̘͖͚̥͕̟͇͈͓̙̖͔̯̺̱̣̖͎͑͒̅̐͛̄́͗̿͛̍͐̒̍̓̂͌̔̈͑̏̽͑̎͛̈́̎̋̕͘̕͠͝͠͠ͅN̸̢̛̙̫̗̜͙̗͚͓̺̩̞̮̬̟͉̲͕̰͍̦̗̺͇͈̩̜̦͖̺͙͓͉̍̊̅̈̉̍̈́̄̒̾̓͗̔̌̐́̈̉̂̈̀̓̒͋̓̒̊̕̚̕̕͠A̸̢̨̧̢̡̢̡̛̛̛̛͉̤̟̪̯̱͈͉̖͕͓̺̦̘͖̱̻̖͔͎̼͉̩̫̝͓̯̙͖͎̤͙̫̬͈̘̾͑̽̀͊̌͑͑͒̿̄̀̏̈́̾́̔̈̃͂̒̿͂̐͑͂̌́̕̚͜͝͠ͅS̴͙̺̠̝̝̜͍̘̗̟̻͇̞̹̘̈́̾̎̋̽̈̀̇͆͒̏̄̈̽̆̑͆̂̽͆̇̾̎̽͗̋̑̕͝P̶̨̡̢̛̪̼̹͉̬̻͇͇͍͓̮̝̦̩̥̻̫̗̺͕̦̳̩̫̫̝̜̜̲̦̻̽̉̾͒͐̈̀͐͋̇̒̽̓̈́͛̐̑̔̆̂̉͑̓̅͋́̏̐̾̿͂̎̋̅͗̾̉̕͘̚͘̚͝͝͝͝ͅD̸̨̨̛͓͇̤̥̻̭͚̭͎̟͍͉̮̫̪̖̘͔͕̘̼̦̻̩̯̹͚̰͈̻̻͇̺͚͙͉͕̮͉̬̼̰̀͐̆͊̈́̌͗͑̈́̆̏͊̓̿̋̀̅̍̀͗̌̍͊̈̂͆̀̆̌̌̈̎̕̚͜͠͠͝͝ͅͅĨ̸̛̛̺͈̮͚͓̘̮̫͚͉̙̭̥͈̣̝̭̦̖̘̮̤̩͈̟̉̆̏́͂̆͒̑̂̔̋̍̌̎͗̒́̾̎̾̑̈̐͌͆͘͜͝͝Ṳ̶̡̢̡̻̺̦̯̥̪̳̭̯̺̻̗̪̞̻̰̜͓̯̥͓̩͍̲͙͕̞̜̪͕̃̉̊̓̓͂̍̊̓̓̄͐̽̀̔̒̀̆̉́̿̒͆͛͗͂̎͘͘͜͝͠͝͠͝ͅG̴̡̨̡̪͉̻̣͕̦͚̥̳̥̩̺̻̻͖̮̰̝̯̩͕͈̱̞̞͖͈̟̓̈́̋̕̚͝ͅͅḾ̷̧̨̛̩͇͉̹̲̤̰̪̝̩̗̳͎̳̟̣̰̘̬̼̠̺̯̖͒̓̄͂̋́̉̄͊̓̅̿̚͠ͅͅͅĂ̷̧̢̧̨̛͇̳͓͚̯͚̩̦͕̗͚̠͚͇̫͇͖̣̻̱̹̙̺̱̖̣͍͙͌̒̒́͒̒̈́̓͑͆̽̀͋̔͜͝S̶̨̙͖͉̻͍̣̦͍̭͔̜̘̖̹̊̌̀̈́́̈̔̒͒̃̾͛͐͘Ơ̸̡̨̡̧̝̳͍̲̘͍̲͚̥̭̼̬̳̙̥̠̝̠͖̹̪̞̬̟̩̟̹̩̝̬͆̿̔̆̐̃̾̏́̈́͒͆̃̐̐͗̃͑̓͗́͌̽̈́̆̅̀͐̕͝͝͝͝ͅ;̷̡̱͍̬̤͚̙̹̐̐̓̎̓́͑͗́̈̈́̎̒͊̾͒͆̌͑̓̃̓̈͑̈́̀͛̚͠͝ͅF̵̢̡̨̝̫͓̖̻͖̭͇̰̬̟͇̹̺̲̦̹̖̥͉̞̲͇͕̮͖͉̖̗̱͓͖͖͓̂̔͐̈́̍̂̏́͊͌̍̈́̋̋̈͐̆́̀̑̋̈́̏̏̀̅͆̿͌͗̐̆̿͐̐̇̕͜͝͠͠͠͝͠͝ͅK̷̡̨̢̢̡̨̨̛̰̙͓̜̲͔̲̞̼̹͈̘͈̙̜̱̫̫̰̜̻̙̼͇͍̥͎͖͔̤̪̉̑͌̾͑̅̂́̔̅͋̈́̈̐͒̎̒͑́̔̔̾̀̈́̈́̓͂̆͊̕͝͝͝͝͝͝ͅM̷͍̥̞͓͉͔͓̪̼̒͊͐͂̋̓̃̊̈́̓̄̐̂̾͌̑̉̇̐́̌͊̐͂̾͊̂̎͌͗͒̈̈́̈́̈́́̊͐̚̚͘͜͝͠͝͝Ą̶̧̢̧̛͖͎̮̦̱̤̫̿͛̍̏̐̈̽͛̀̉̚O̸̢̥̝̰͇̫̙͎͔̱̗̮̝̲̰͕̣̖̖̙͍̙̼͍̘͓̤͍͈͕͂͗͛̈́͌̍̆̎̊͛̐͋̓̃̀͝͠;̷̧̢̭̘͚̖̥̲̼͍̘̱̮͎͕͔̱̤̞̦͙̞̩̩͌̓͗̂̓͘͜͜Í̴̡̧̡̝̺̣̖̜̖̝̗͙͔͖͔̱͔̘̯̠͚͙̖̜͖͕̙̜̥͇̬̞͙̰̪̈́̾͒̓̈́́̑͒̽͊̑͊͂̌̃̈̽̂͌̀̊̔̋͋̒̎͆͘̚̕͘G̵̡̖͚͓̞̀͌̍̑̓̾̓̒̽̉͑͂͑̆̇̀̍͊̉̀̌̏̀́́̄́̉͐̇͗̚̚͝͠͝͝͝͝H̵̨̡͔̦̟̠̠̺͕̦̦͓̻͕̙̽̋͒͑̔̽̈͊̃̿̀̀͂̉̅̆̑̓̑̅̽͛̿̄͗̃̔͆̐̚͘͠͝D̸̡̡̢̛̛͚̝̠͓̠̟͖̳̞̺̳͇̤̩̝͈͓͙̖̗̟͖͕̹̖̥̰͔̭̖̳̘͚̰̪̫͉͓̞̩̬̾͗̓͑̈́͋͐̈̎͑̏͂͆̓̋̊͆̋̄́̅̇̕̕͜͝͝ͅL̶̥̘͔̲̝̩͔͕̬̜̪̖̪͙̥̃͒̿͐̓͒͆̃̉̈̃̃̄̚͝ͅÄ̸̡̛͉̥̤̣̦͕̦̞͍͖͈͙̭̯̯̙̗̰͍͚͕͚̣͎͓͙̥̗̹̬̙̹̙̻̯̠̙̳͕͙̦́̅̏̈́̿̂̏̇͘͜ͅͅS̷͖͖̪͕̖̩̳̘̋̌́̾̓̆͗̿͐̈́͛̄̈́̐̍͘̚͘̚Į̷̛̛̳̦̠̦̇̐́̒̌̇̽̏͋̽̂̎̈́̐͑̈̽̊̍̐̓́̿̔̋̍̉͂̑̑̓̚̚͠͝͠͝Ư̶̡̨̧̡̙̠̺̺̥̙̺͇̻̭̱͚̤̥̙̳̰̳̮̳̯͍͚͙̙̿͋̇̊͐̄̈͑̈̐̾͆̿͌̀̑̌̇̚͜͝͝͝ͅͅḠ̷̢̛̛̙̤̟̳͍͑̊̌̏̿̐̇́̈̐̃́̌͜͝͝ ̢̡̧̨̧̯̩͖̻̯͈̖̦̰̙͎̟͉͉͖̲̹̯͇͙̤̞͍̜͖̲̫͇̝̪̜̤̺̫̀̀̀͋̐̈́̓͛̿̒͂̋́̇̕͜Ǵ̴̛̬̻͙̯͙̓̍͒̀̽̈́̈̉̃̿̈́̆͛̊̌̀̇̀̀͐̑͂͊́̈̾̈͌̊̾͆̉̅̄̆͌̏͐̚͝͝H̸̨̡̧̢̢̨͇͈̪̺̮̠̲̞̠͔̤̣̦̦͕̺͖̙̣̘̩͕̮̝͇̪̺̼͔̪̟͔͎̪̩͉͔͉͕͈̃͆̈́͑͑͌̕̕̕̕͜͜͠P̵̧̛͈̠̜̱̩̻̳̹̻͙͇̐̅̈́́͛̉̓̐̐͂̇̃́̋̀̂̃̄̓̊̂̊̔͆̿͊̉͘̚À̸͉͍̣̫̺̜͊̔͐̋̈́͗̈́̓̄̿̑͌͐̈́̓̎̇̀͗̅̍̒͌̇̽̕͘͘͘͝9̷̡̙͕͈͈̤͇̝̦̲̤͕̯͔̮̠̌́̉̎̌̇͊̒̆̒̓̈́͒̋͐̈́́̿̄̒̎̃̓͂̐͗̀͗̾̽̍̈́̓̍͛̿͛͘̚̕͝͠Ḙ̶̢̨̡̳͉̗̩͕͓͕̻͔͙̻̣̙̩̣̩̹͖̖̞̯͓͖̯͊̎͋͂̒̓̏̾̌̋͂̅̅̔̕͜͝ͅͅW̴̰͓̺͈͍̖͎̱͌̌̓̀̈́̇̋̌͌̿̏̃̄̔́͐͛̄̏́̓̀̈͒̉̀͋͌͐̔̀̃͂͘͝͝͠G̸̨̢̧̡̯̩̩̯̳͍̦̜͕̣̩̙͉̞͇͕̳̥̱̦͓̫͖̙̦̦̬̦̞̣͓̈͂̃̿̉̆̒͑̍̌̄8̵̢͍̰̍̃̾̃̅̒̽̌̀̄̓̒̌̌͊͑̏̅̑̈́̀͋̀̿̐͋̋̾́̍̐͆͐͘͝͝͝͝Ÿ̴̧̡̛̝͈̯͇̭̣̤̫̼́̌̐͆̃̌͑̃̇̿̑͋́͑̅̓̓̌̂͑̏̇̃̈́̔͘͘
